itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
The adventure begins at 11:30 AM with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada or El Gouna. You will be greeted by a skilled driver and guide for a transfer to the desert entry point. From there, the journey continues aboard a Jeep 4×4, traversing 35 kilometers of rugged terrain and majestic mountains to reach the heart of the wilderness.

Upon arriving at the authentic Bedouin village, you will be welcomed by the locals. This visit offers a chance to engage with the community and observe their traditional way of life. You can embark on a gentle camel ride around the settlement, and for those seeking an adrenaline rush, a quad bike experience is available to explore the surrounding sands.

As evening approaches, you will watch a stunning desert sunset, transforming the sky with vibrant colors. Following this, a BBQ dinner will be served, accompanied by Bedouin tea. The night concludes with a cultural performance featuring local music and folklore under the starlit sky. After the show, you will transfer back to your hotel, carrying memories of the desert's silence and beauty.

itineraries.title: Arrival and Luxor East Bank
itineraries.content:
The tour begins with a transfer from Hurghada to Luxor in a modern, air-conditioned vehicle. Upon arrival in Luxor, you will check into your hotel to freshen up. You will then enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before starting your exploration of the East Bank.

The afternoon is dedicated to the massive Karnak Temple complex, a vast open-air museum and the largest ancient religious site in the world, dedicated to the god Amun-Ra. Following this, you will visit the Luxor Temple, located in the city center, known for its well-preserved statues and obelisks. After the tour, you will be transferred back to your hotel in Luxor for an overnight stay. Meals: Lunch.

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank and Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast at your hotel, the tour continues to the West Bank of the Nile, the ancient necropolis of Thebes. The first stop is the Valley of the Kings, where you will enter the elaborate underground tombs of the New Kingdom pharaohs.

Next, you will visit the Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari, a stunning structure built into the limestone cliffs that honors Egypt’s famous female pharaoh. The West Bank tour concludes with a viewing of the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues representing Amenhotep III. After finishing the sightseeing, you will have lunch at a local restaurant before beginning the return drive to your hotel in Hurghada. Meals: Breakfast, Lunch.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
The adventure begins with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada at 9:00 AM. You will be transferred by an air-conditioned car to the quad bike station, which serves as the starting point for the safari. Upon arrival, expert guides will provide a comprehensive 10-minute safety briefing and instructions on how to handle the quad bike, ensuring you are comfortable before the ride begins.

Once ready, you will start the engine for a 12-mile (20 km) journey through the desert. The route takes you across vast flats and sand dunes, offering expansive views of the morning desert landscape. The drive leads to an authentic Bedouin village, where you will take a break to experience local culture.

At the village, you will be greeted with traditional hospitality, including "welcome tea." You will have time to relax, smoke shisha, and listen to stories about life in the Sahara from your guide. The stop also provides an opportunity to observe Bedouin craftsmanship. After the visit, you will ride your quad bike back along the same path to the station. Finally, a vehicle will be waiting to transfer you back to your hotel in Hurghada.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
The tour begins with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada in an air-conditioned vehicle, transferring you directly to the marina. Upon arrival, you will board the yellow Sindbad Submarine to commence the underwater portion of the trip. The vessel descends to a depth of approximately 72 feet (22 meters), allowing you to observe the marine environment from a unique perspective.

During the 50-minute dive, you will be seated comfortably in front of large panoramic windows. These viewing ports provide clear visibility of the Red Sea's coral reefs and diverse aquatic life. You can expect to see various species, including parrotfish, grouper, and other exotic fish, as well as stingrays, eels, and turtles navigating the water.

After the underwater exploration concludes, the submarine will resurface and return to the dock. You will then disembark and meet your driver for the return transfer to your hotel, completing the excursion.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
The tour begins in the early morning with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada. You will travel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle for the drive to Luxor. Upon arrival in the city, the first stop is the East Bank to explore the Karnak Temple complex. Here, you will walk through the celebrated Hypostyle Hall, known for its forest of 134 massive sandstone columns, and learn about the site's history as a major place of worship in ancient Egypt.

Following the visit to Karnak, you will take a break for lunch at a local restaurant, where you can sample authentic Egyptian cuisine. After the meal, the tour proceeds to the West Bank of the Nile. The afternoon exploration starts with a viewing of the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues representing Pharaoh Amenhotep III that have stood for millennia.

Next, you will move on to the Valley of the Kings, the burial ground for pharaohs of the New Kingdom. You will enter several of the adorned tombs to see the intricate wall carvings and colors that have been preserved for centuries. The tour continues to the Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari, a mortuary temple dedicated to the famous female pharaoh, designed with unique terraced architecture built into the limestone cliffs.

Before leaving Luxor, the itinerary includes stops at local workshops, such as papyrus institutes and alabaster factories, where you can observe traditional craftsmanship and shop for souvenirs. As the day concludes, you will board your vehicle for the return transfer to your hotel in Hurghada.

Guests travel by boat to reach the island, where they can explore the marine life of the Red Sea, engage in beach activities like volleyball, or simply relax in the lounge areas before returning to the mainland.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
The day begins with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada in an air-conditioned van, transferring you to the marina. From there, you will board a Mahmya boat for a scenic voyage across the Red Sea. The sailing time is approximately one hour, offering passengers expansive views of the coastline and open water before arriving at the southern shores of Giftun Island, where Mahmya is located.

Upon arrival at Mahmya Beach, you can enjoy the natural surroundings of the National Park. The island features a protected lagoon with calm, crystal-clear waters ideal for snorkeling. Entering the water, you will have the chance to observe vibrant coral heads and a variety of colorful marine life in their natural habitat. For those preferring land-based activities, the island offers amenities such as beach volleyball and a water trampoline.

During your stay, you can utilize the island’s lounge area, which provides complimentary Wi-Fi access. The itinerary includes time to dine at the island’s restaurant, which serves a selection of seafood and Italian dishes, offering panoramic views of the sea. You may also unwind with a beverage at the bar. As the afternoon concludes, you will board the boat for the return journey to the marina, followed by a transfer back to your hotel.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
The tour begins in the early morning with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada, followed by a transfer to the airport for a flight to Cairo. Upon arrival in Cairo, you will meet your English-speaking guide to start the exploration of the Giza Plateau. The first stop includes the Great Pyramids, where you will observe the architectural scale of these ancient structures. You will also visit the Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple of Khafre, learning about their historical context and construction.

After exploring the Giza complex, the tour proceeds to a local restaurant for a late lunch. Following the meal, you will visit the Grand Egyptian Museum. Here, you will have the opportunity to view a vast collection of artifacts, including the celebrated treasures of King Tutankhamun, displaying the artistry and history of ancient Egypt in a modern setting.

The afternoon focuses on the diverse religious and cultural history of the city. You will head to Coptic Cairo to visit the Hanging Church and the Ben Ezra Synagogue, sites that highlight the area's Christian and Jewish heritage. The final stop is Islamic Cairo, where you will walk through the historic Khan El Khalili bazaar, a marketplace known for its traditional crafts and architecture. At the end of the tour, you will transfer back to the airport for your return flight to Hurghada, followed by a transfer to your hotel.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary

Your day begins with a comfortable pickup from your hotel in an air-conditioned van, transferring you directly to the marina. Upon arrival, you will board a boat and depart for a scenic cruise across the Red Sea. As you head toward the Snorkeling Trip to Giftun Island location, you can relax on the deck and take in the panoramic views of the coast and the open water.

Once the boat reaches the Giftun Island National Park, you will have the opportunity to disembark and explore the island's sandy beaches. You can spend your time swimming in the crystal-clear waters or using the provided snorkeling gear to discover the vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life inhabiting the area. Lucky visitors may even spot dolphins swimming nearby. For those seeking more activity, the island offers access to water sports such as jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides.

During the trip, a lunch featuring Egyptian cuisine will be served on board the boat, allowing you to dine while surrounded by sea views. After lunch, there is ample time to sunbathe or stroll along the shoreline, enjoying the peaceful island atmosphere. In the late afternoon, the boat will return to the marina, where your vehicle will be waiting to transfer you back to your hotel.

itineraries.title: The Legend of Isis Reborn
itineraries.content:
The Twilight Journey Your magical evening begins with a pickup from your hotel or Nile Cruise in Aswan. You will be transferred to the marina to board a private motorboat. As you sail towards Agilkia Island, the silhouette of the temple rises from the water, bathed in soft light—a photographer’s dream and a truly romantic start to the night.

The Walking Tour Upon docking, the show begins. This unique performance takes you on a guided walk through the temple grounds. As lights illuminate specific pillars and reliefs, the narration brings them to life. You will walk through the First Pylon and the Forecourt, following the voices that tell the story of the Goddess Isis, her husband Osiris, and their son Horus. The interplay of shadow and light on the ancient sandstone creates a mystical ambiance that you cannot experience during the day.

The Grand Finale For the second part of the show, you will take a seat in the open-air theater overlooking the inner sanctuary. Here, the story concludes with a dramatic display of lights washing over the entire island, celebrating the resurrection of Osiris and the enduring power of love.

Return to Aswan After the applause fades, you will board your boat for the return journey to the mainland, the temple glowing behind you in the distance. Your private vehicle will be waiting to transfer you comfortably back to your hotel or cruise ship.

Traveling in the comfort of a private air-conditioned vehicle, you will traverse the Nile Valley to explore the monumental temples of the East Bank and the royal tombs of the West Bank. Guided by an expert Egyptologist, this tour is the perfect way to witness the glory of the Pharaohs in a single, unforgettable day.

itineraries.title: The Road to Thebes
itineraries.content:
The Journey Begins Your expedition starts with an early morning pickup from your hotel or cruise in Aswan. You will settle into a modern, air-conditioned vehicle for the approximately 3.5 to 4-hour drive to Luxor. Watch the scenery change as you pass lush green fields, traditional villages, and the desert edge, arriving in Luxor ready for discovery.

The East Bank: Karnak Temple Your first stop is the colossal Karnak Temple Complex. Your Egyptologist will lead you down the Avenue of Sphinxes and into the Great Hypostyle Hall, where 134 massive columns tower above you. Learn about the Theban Triad (Amun, Mut, and Khonsu) and decipher the hieroglyphs that cover every inch of these walls.

Lunch & The West Bank After exploring the East Bank, enjoy a relaxing Late Lunch at a local restaurant, savoring delicious Egyptian cuisine. You will then cross the Nile to the West Bank, the ancient land of the dead.

Valley of the Kings Here, hidden deep within the limestone hills, lies the Valley of the Kings. You will enter three of the spectacular royal tombs, admiring the vibrant colors that have survived for over 3,000 years. (Note: The tomb of King Tutankhamun requires an extra ticket, but seeing his mummy is a bucket-list experience for many).

Hatshepsut & Memnon Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari. Its terraces rise from the desert floor, blending perfectly with the sheer limestone cliffs behind it. On your return, make a stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues of Amenhotep III that are all that remain of a once-great temple. Finally, visit an authentic Alabaster Factory to watch locals craft stunning souvenirs from the region's famous stone.

Conclusion At the end of this history-packed day (around 5:00 PM), you have the flexibility to be transferred back to your hotel in Aswan, or dropped off at a hotel, airport, or cruise ship in Luxor if you are continuing your travels there.

itineraries.title: Ancient Secrets & Modern Marvels
itineraries.content:
Your day of discovery begins with a comfortable pickup from your hotel or Nile Cruise in Aswan by a private air-conditioned vehicle. Your first stop is a testament to modern engineering: the Aswan High Dam. Built in the 1960s, this massive structure holds back the waters of Lake Nasser, the world's largest man-made lake. Your guide will explain the dam's pivotal role in Egypt's economy and agriculture, offering a stark contrast to the ancient wonders you are about to see.

Next, you will travel back in time at the Granite Quarries. Here lies the Unfinished Obelisk, a colossal pillar of stone that was abandoned thousands of years ago due to a crack. Had it been finished, it would have been the largest obelisk ever raised by the Ancient Egyptians. Walking around this sleeping giant gives you a rare glimpse into the stone-cutting techniques used by the builders of the pyramids.

The highlight of your tour awaits at the water's edge. You will board a motorboat for a short, delightful ride to Agilkia Island, the new home of Philae Temple. Rescued from the rising waters of the Nile by UNESCO, this temple complex is one of Egypt’s most beautiful. Dedicated to the Goddess Isis, the temple walls tell the tragic and triumphant story of Osiris and Horus. Walking through its colonnades, you will feel the spiritual atmosphere that has drawn pilgrims here for millennia.

After filling your mind with history, you will relax and enjoy a Late Lunch at a local restaurant, where you can taste authentic Egyptian dishes. Finally, your driver will transfer you back to your hotel, leaving you with unforgettable memories of Aswan’s treasures.

itineraries.title: The Cairo Adventure
itineraries.content:
04:30 AM (Approx): Departure from Aswan Your day begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel in Aswan. You will be transferred by a private air-conditioned vehicle to Aswan International Airport for your short flight (approx. 1 hour 25 minutes) to Cairo.

Arrival & The Giza Plateau Upon arrival in Cairo, your private Egyptologist guide will welcome you at the airport. You will head directly to the Giza Plateau, home to the legendary Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Your guide will unravel the mysteries of their construction and the lives of the kings they were built for. You will then proceed to the valley to stand before the Great Sphinx and visit the Valley Temple, the site of ancient mummification rituals.

Lunch & The City Center After a morning of ancient wonders, relax and recharge with a sumptuous Lunch at a top-rated local restaurant, where you can sample authentic Egyptian dishes.

The Egyptian Museum Next, you will drive to Tahrir Square to visit the world-renowned Egyptian Museum. Here, you will navigate through thousands of years of art and history. The highlight is undoubtedly the Tutankhamun Collection, featuring his famous golden mask and sarcophagus, alongside mummies, statues, and jewelry that tell the story of Egypt’s golden age.

Old Cairo & Khan El Khalili Your journey continues into Coptic Cairo, a spiritual haven where you will visit the Hanging Church (built on the ruins of a Roman fortress) and the Ben Ezra Synagogue. Finally, immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Islamic Cairo at the Khan El Khalili Bazaar. Wander through labyrinthine alleys filled with the scent of spices, the shine of copper lamps, and the chatter of local merchants.

Evening: Return to Aswan As the sun sets over the capital, you will be transferred back to Cairo Airport for your return flight to Aswan. Upon landing, our representative will be waiting to drive you comfortably back to your hotel, your mind filled with memories of the Pharaohs.

title.rendered: Abu Simbel from Aswan by Flight: The Majestic Day Trip

itineraries.title: A Flight to the Edge of Ancient Egypt
itineraries.content:
Your journey begins with a private pickup from your hotel in Aswan. You will be transferred in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle to Aswan International Airport to board your short flight to Abu Simbel. As you soar above the desert, enjoy breathtaking views of the shimmering Lake Nasser, the world’s largest man-made lake.

Upon landing, your private Egyptologist guide will be waiting to whisk you away to the temple complex. As you approach the site, the massive façade of the Great Temple of Ramses II rises from the mountainside. Your guide will explain the significance of the four 20-meter statues and lead you inside, where the hall is lined with Osirid pillars and walls covered in detailed hieroglyphs depicting the Battle of Kadesh.

Just steps away stands the smaller, yet incredibly beautiful Temple of Queen Nefertari. It is one of the few instances in Egyptian art where the statues of the King and Queen are of equal size, a testament to Ramses’ deep love for his wife.

Before leaving, you will learn about the UNESCO International Campaign to Save the Monuments of Nubia. Your guide will explain how these massive structures were sliced into blocks and reassembled on higher ground—a feat of engineering as impressive as their original construction.

After a morning filled with history and wonder, you will fly back to Aswan. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to a local restaurant for a delicious Late Lunch, savoring the flavors of the region before being dropped off at your hotel, memories of the Pharaohs fresh in your mind.

itineraries.title: Temples of the Lake & Nubian Culture
itineraries.content:
Your day of discovery begins with a pickup from your hotel in Aswan by a private air-conditioned vehicle. Your first stop is the impressive Temple of Kalabsha. Often overlooked by crowds, this sandstone masterpiece was built during the Roman era by Emperor Augustus and dedicated to the Nubian fertility god, Mandulis. Originally located 50km south, it was painstakingly moved to its current location near the High Dam to save it from the waters of Lake Nasser. The site offers panoramic views of the lake and the High Dam itself.

Next, you will head to the marina to board a motorboat for a magical ride to Agilkia Island, the new home of the Philae Temple. Known as the "Pearl of Egypt," this complex was the last outpost of the ancient Egyptian religion. As you walk through its colonnades and courtyards, your Egyptologist will recount the myth of Isis and Osiris and explain the massive UNESCO rescue mission that moved this temple stone by stone from the submerged island of Philae.

After immersing yourself in ancient history, you will take a break to enjoy a Late Lunch at a carefully selected local restaurant, savoring traditional Egyptian dishes.

The final leg of your journey brings you to the Nubian Museum. Winner of the Aga Khan Award for Architecture, this museum is a treasure trove of history. Here, you will trace the timeline of the Nubian people from prehistoric times to the present day. View stunning artifacts from the Kingdom of Kush, Coptic frescoes, and life-size dioramas depicting traditional Nubian village life. It is the perfect way to understand the culture of the region you are visiting.

As the tour concludes, you will be transferred back to your hotel with a deeper appreciation for Aswan’s rich past and vibrant present.

itineraries.title: The Colors of the Nile
itineraries.content:
Your cultural journey begins with a pickup from your hotel or cruise ship in Aswan. You will transfer to the dock to board your private boat. You have the freedom to choose your mode of travel: a traditional Felucca, where you sail quietly with the wind, or a modern Motorboat for a faster, steady cruise.

As you navigate the Nile, you will glide past Elephantine Island, the oldest inhabited part of Aswan, seeing ancient ruins and lush palm groves from the water. The scenery changes as you approach the Nubian Village (often Gharb Soheil), located on the West Bank. The first thing you will notice is the vibrant architecture—houses painted in bright blues, yellows, and oranges, reflecting the sun and the river.

Upon arrival, you will step ashore and be welcomed into a local Nubian home. The Nubian people are famous for their hospitality. You will be greeted with a warm smile and a cup of traditional "Mint Tea." Sit with the family, learn about their history, and perhaps see the small crocodiles that many families keep as traditional pets—a fascinating cultural quirk!

After your house visit, take some time to explore the sandy village streets. You can shop for aromatic spices, colorful scarves, or handmade jewelry in the local market. To complete your experience, enjoy a delicious Late Lunch at a local restaurant, savoring authentic Egyptian cuisine with a view of the Nile.

As the day winds down (around 6:30 PM), your boat will take you back down the river, transferring you safely to your hotel or cruise ship with memories of a warm and colorful adventure.

itineraries.title: A Journey Through the Heart of Aswan
itineraries.content:
Your cultural adventure begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel or Nile Cruise. You will be transferred by a private air-conditioned vehicle to meet your traditional horse carriage—a mode of transport that has served this city for generations.

As you climb aboard, you will set off on a leisurely ride through the city, guided by an expert Egyptologist who will bring the streets to life with fascinating stories. The tour takes you beyond the standard tourist trail and into the real Aswan. You will glide past the imposing El-Tabia Mosque, sitting high on a hill surrounded by scenic gardens, and admire the beautiful architecture of the Coptic Orthodox Cathedral, a symbol of the city’s rich religious diversity.

The journey continues along the famous Nile Corniche, where the cool river breeze meets the warmth of the city. Here, you will capture perfect photos of the legendary Old Cataract Hotel, a masterpiece of Victorian grandeur where history was written. As you trot through the diverse neighborhoods, you will witness the daily life of the Nubian and Egyptian locals, seeing the vibrant souks and ancient streets up close.

To complete the experience, your carriage will stop at a traditional local café. Sit back and savor a complimentary cup of Egyptian tea or fresh coffee, soaking in the atmosphere before your carriage returns you to your vehicle for a transfer back to your hotel.

title.rendered: Felucca Ride on the Nile at Luxor City

content.rendered:
Experience Egypt’s timeless Nile River beauty with our Felucca Ride on the Nile at Luxor City. Drift along the gentle currents of the Nile, soaking in the historical significance that has nourished Egypt since the time of the Pharaohs. Relax on our traditional sailing boat, surrounded by authentic landscapes and local life. Witness water buffaloes grazing, camels and donkeys passing by, and children playing at the water’s edge.

We will sail to Banana Island, where you will walk through lush banana plantations and savor traditional Egyptian treats like fresh bananas and tea. As the sun sets over the West Bank of Luxor, embrace the captivating scenery where the desert meets the river. This journey intertwines past and present, crafting cherished memories on this unforgettable, cultural river experience.

faqs.title: Is it safe?
faqs.content: Yes, balloon pilots in Luxor are highly trained and certified by the Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority. Flights are subject to strict weather and safety regulations and will be cancelled if wind conditions are not ideal.

faqs.title: What should I wear?
faqs.content: It is recommended to dress in layers. It can be quite chilly in the early morning before sunrise, but it warms up quickly once the sun is up. Wear comfortable, closed-toe flat shoes suitable for getting into the basket and walking on uneven ground upon landing.

faqs.title: Do we fly over the Valley of the Kings?
faqs.content: Balloons are dependent on wind direction. While pilots aim to show you the major sites, the flight path varies daily. You will almost always see the temples of Hatshepsut, the Ramesseum, and the Nobles' Tombs, but flying directly over the Valley of the Kings is strictly controlled and wind-dependent.

faqs.title: Can children fly?
faqs.content: Children are generally allowed if they are over a certain age (usually 15 years old) and tall enough to see over the edge of the basket. Please confirm specific age policies when booking.

faqs.title: What time is pickup?
faqs.content: Pickup is very early, usually around 4:00 AM to 4:45 AM, to ensure you are in the air before the sun breaks the horizon.

itineraries.title: Half-Day East Bank Discovery
itineraries.content:
Your adventure commences with a convenient pickup from your hotel, Nile cruise, train station, or airport in Luxor.

First on our itinerary is the awe-inspiring Karnak Temple, a colossal architectural marvel built over the course of 2,000 years. It is a vast open-air museum and the largest religious site in the world. Marvel at the Avenue of Sphinxes at the entrance, the imposing pylons, and the breathtaking Hypostyle Hall with its forest of 134 gigantic columns. Delve into the mysteries of the sanctuary of Philip III Arrhidaeus, the Akh Menu (Festival Hall) of Thutmose III, and admire the towering obelisks and the serene Sacred Lake.

Next, we venture to the captivating Luxor Temple, located in the city center. Historically linked to Karnak by the illustrious Sphinx Avenue (parts of which you can see), this temple was built largely by the esteemed pharaohs Amenhotep III and Ramses II. It exudes timeless beauty and historical significance, having been used as a place of worship continuously for thousands of years.

Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable guide will offer fascinating insights into the rituals and history of Thebes. You will have ample free time at both temples to capture photos and soak in the atmosphere. The journey concludes with a drop-off at your hotel, cruise, or preferred destination in Luxor.

faqs.title: Why can't the guide go inside the tombs?
faqs.content: To preserve the silence and sanctity of the tombs and to prevent overcrowding in the narrow corridors, the Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities prohibits guides from lecturing inside. Your guide will give you a full detailed explanation outside, show you pictures, and tell you what to look for before you enter on your own.

faqs.title: Is the tomb of Tutankhamun included?
faqs.content: No, the standard entry ticket to the Valley of the Kings includes access to three tombs open on that day. The tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62) requires a separate "extra" ticket, which can be purchased at the gate.

faqs.title: Can I take photos in the Valley of the Kings?
faqs.content: Photography with mobile phones is currently allowed in most standard tombs for free. However, using professional cameras (DSLRs) usually requires purchasing a specific photography permit at the ticket office. Flash photography is strictly forbidden in all tombs.

faqs.title: Is there a lot of walking?
faqs.content: Yes, the West Bank involves significant walking, often on uneven, sandy, or paved surfaces under the sun. Comfortable walking shoes, a hat, and sunscreen are highly recommended.

content.rendered: Step into ancient Egypt’s enchanting realm with our captivating Sound and Light Show at Karnak Temples. Experience over 2,000 years of history through illuminated narratives of pharaohs like Tutankhamun, Ramses II, and Queen Hatshepsut. This unique spectacle begins with a walking tour through the majestic Colonnade and Hypostyle Hall, followed by a seated viewing by the Sacred Lake. The show is a mesmerizing blend of history and entertainment suitable for all ages.

faqs.title: Is the show available in languages other than English?
faqs.content: The live narration is broadcast in one language depending on the schedule (often English on specific days), but headsets are provided for simultaneous translation into French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, and Japanese.

faqs.title: Is there a lot of walking?
faqs.content: The first half of the show (approx. 30–45 minutes) is a walking tour through the temple grounds. The ground can be uneven and sandy, so comfortable flat walking shoes are highly recommended. The second half is seated.

faqs.title: Is this suitable for children?
faqs.content: Yes, the show is family-friendly and visually engaging. However, the walking portion requires moving with the group, so very young children might need a stroller (though the terrain is rough).

faqs.title: What time does the tour start?
faqs.content: The show times vary by season (winter vs. summer). Your pickup time will be confirmed upon booking, usually around 6:00 PM or 7:00 PM.

title.rendered: Tour to Danderah and Abydos from Luxor

content.rendered: Embark on a mesmerizing Tour to Danderah and Abydos from Luxor to explore two of the most significant temples of the Ptolemaic dynasty. Guided by an expert, you will travel by road along the Nile to the Temple of Horus in Edfu, the best-preserved ancient temple in Egypt. Continue to the unique Temple of Kom Ombo, a double temple dedicated to both the falcon god Haroeris and the crocodile god Sobek, famous for its ancient medical reliefs. This immersive odyssey offers a deep dive into history before returning you to Luxor.

faqs.title: How long is the drive?
faqs.content: This is a full-day trip. Edfu is approximately 2 hours south of Luxor, and Kom Ombo is another 1.5 hours south of Edfu. The total round-trip driving time is significant, so prepare for a long but rewarding day.

faqs.title: Is this a boat tour?
faqs.content: No, this specific itinerary is a land-based tour using an air-conditioned van. While you follow the path of the Nile, you are traveling by road.

faqs.title: Can this tour end in Aswan?
faqs.content: The itinerary provided specifies a return to Luxor. However, because Kom Ombo is actually closer to Aswan than Luxor, many travelers customize this route as a "transfer tour" to get from Luxor to Aswan. If you wish to be dropped off in Aswan instead of returning to Luxor, please inquire before booking.

faqs.title: What should I wear?
faqs.content: Comfortable walking shoes are essential for the stone temple floors. Modest, breathable clothing, a hat, and sunglasses are recommended for the sun.

itineraries.title: Half-Day Cultural Tour
itineraries.content:
Discover the treasures of ancient Egypt on our half-day tour, an enriching journey through the cultural wonders of Old Thebes. Your adventure begins with a pick-up from your hotel in Luxor.

First, step into the captivating Luxor Museum. Since its inauguration in 1975, this museum has been celebrated as a gem of Egyptian heritage. Unlike its larger counterpart in Cairo, the Luxor Museum deliberately focuses on quality rather than quantity. Be mesmerized by the carefully chosen collection of artifacts, statues, and jewelry, displayed with excellent lighting and clarity to enhance your understanding of Theban art.

Next, delve into the ancient art of preservation at the Mummification Museum. Located along the scenic Corniche overlooking the majestic Nile River, this unique museum offers profound insight into the rituals and beliefs surrounding the afterlife. It goes beyond the typical display of mummies to explore the techniques, tools, and substances used in the mummification process for both humans and animals.

After the visits, enjoy a late lunch at a local restaurant. Our expert guides will accompany you throughout the journey, offering engaging narratives. Finally, you will be comfortably transported back to your Luxor hotel.

faqs.title: How is the Luxor Museum different from the Cairo Museum?
faqs.content: The Luxor Museum is much smaller but is often praised for its superior organization, lighting, and presentation. It displays a select collection of very high-quality items found in the Luxor area, including a cache of statues found at Luxor Temple and two royal mummies (Ahmose I and Ramses I).

faqs.title: What can I see in the Mummification Museum?
faqs.content: You will see the actual tools used by ancient embalmers (hooks, knives), the organic materials used (natron, oils), canopic jars, and mummified animals (such as crocodiles, cats, and rams).

faqs.title: Is this tour suitable for children?
faqs.content: Yes, it is very educational. However, the Mummification Museum deals with death and preserved bodies, so parents should gauge their children's sensitivity to these topics.

faqs.title: Can I take photos?
faqs.content: Yes, photography is generally allowed inside both museums, though the use of flash is strictly prohibited. In some seasons, a separate photography ticket may be required for professional cameras (mobile photography is usually free).

faqs.title: What time does the tour start?
faqs.content: These museums are often open in the morning and again in the evening. The tour can be arranged for either shift, though evening visits are popular for the illuminated atmosphere of the Corniche. Please check your specific booking time.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
West Bank Exploration Step back in time as we collect you from your hotel or Nile cruise in Luxor, escorting you in a private, air-conditioned vehicle to the West Bank of the Nile.

The journey commences at the iconic Medinet Habu, where the grand Mortuary Temple of Ramses III majestically stands. Unearth its captivating history, view the deep relief carvings, and explore the remarkable structures concealed within its walls.

Your expedition continues to Deir el-Medina, the ancient village where the skilled artisans, stonecutters, and painters who created the royal tombs lived and worked. See the remains of their homes and their own beautifully decorated tombs.

The pinnacle of this adventure awaits at the mesmerizing Valley of the Queens (Biban el-Harim), the burial place of the wives of the Pharaohs. Immerse yourself in the tales of the past as you traverse these ornate tombs.

Our knowledgeable guides will enthrall you throughout the tour with intriguing stories of Egypt’s wealthy heritage. After the tour, enjoy a late lunch at a local restaurant. As the day concludes, we’ll transfer you back to your Luxor hotel, leaving you with cherished memories of an awe-inspiring journey.

faqs.title: What is the difference between this and the standard West Bank tour?
faqs.content: Standard West Bank tours typically cover the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and Colossi of Memnon. This tour focuses on the "hidden gems" like Medinet Habu (often considered the best-preserved), the Artisans' Village, and the Valley of the Queens.

faqs.title: Is entry to Nefertari's tomb included?
faqs.content: Entry to the specific tomb of Queen Nefertari in the Valley of the Queens is not included in standard tickets and requires a separate, expensive ticket purchased on-site. The standard ticket included in this tour covers other impressive tombs in the valley.

faqs.title: Is there a lot of walking?
faqs.content: There is moderate walking involved at each site on uneven, sandy, or paved ground. Comfortable walking shoes are recommended.

faqs.title: What should I bring?
faqs.content: Sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses are essential as the West Bank can be very hot and exposed to the sun.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
Relaxing Nile Sail Your experience begins with a pickup from your hotel in Cairo or Giza by our representative. You will be transferred in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle to the Nile dock.

Board your private Felucca, a traditional wooden sailboat with large canvas sails and comfortable seating cushions. As the captain navigates the boat using the wind and currents, sit back and relax.

Depending on your chosen time:

  • Sunrise/Morning: Enjoy the fresh breeze and watch the city wake up.
  • Sunset: Witness the sky turn gold and purple behind the palm trees and city buildings—the most popular time for photography.
  • Evening: See the city lights reflecting on the water and enjoy the cool night air.

This ride is an excellent opportunity to disconnect and enjoy the simple beauty of the Nile. After the ride (typically 1 to 2 hours), you will return to the dock and be transferred back to your hotel.

The highlight of the trip is setting up camp in the open desert to sleep under a breathtaking blanket of stars. The next day, enjoy breakfast in the tranquil wilderness before returning to Cairo.

itineraries.title: Bahariya Oasis & White Desert Adventure
itineraries.content:
Embark on an exciting journey from Cairo in the early morning (approx. 4-hour drive). Upon arrival at Bahariya Oasis, we switch to a well-equipped 4x4 Land Cruiser to begin our off-road adventure.

Visit the captivating Black Desert, known for its volcanic hills, and stop at the El Hez Village to see the cold springs. Enjoy a delightful lunch amidst these remarkable landscapes.

Continue towards the Crystal Mountain, a ridge of sparkling quartz crystals, and drive through the picturesque Aqapat Valley (Valley of Wonders) with its dramatic rock formations. Finally, reach the White Desert National Park. Explore the mesmerizing limestone sculptures, such as the "Mushroom," "Chicken," and "Tents" formations.

As the sun sets, we will set up our camp in the heart of the White Desert. Enjoy a delicious dinner cooked over an open fire and spend the night sleeping under the breathtaking starlit sky.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Sunrise & Return to Cairo
itineraries.content:
Wake up to a stunning desert sunrise and savor a delectable breakfast at the campsite. Take some final photos of the serene beauty of the desert before packing up.

Our jeep will transport us back to the Bahariya Oasis, where we will transfer back to our private car for the journey back to Cairo. You will be dropped off at your hotel in the afternoon.

  • Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Giza Pyramids Sound & Light Show
itineraries.content:
Join us for an unforgettable evening as we take you on a captivating journey through ancient Egyptian history at the amazing Sound and Light Show of the Pyramids of Giza.

Our experienced representative will pick you up from your hotel in a modern air-conditioned vehicle and take you to the Giza Plateau for this wonderful event.

Prepare to be enchanted as the show reveals the fascinating stories of the Giza pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Immerse yourself in the rich heritage of the ancient Egyptians as you watch the Great Sphinx, the steadfast guardian of the necropolis for more than 4,500 years, come to life before your very eyes.

With stunning laser lights and captivating narration, the show beautifully depicts the construction of the pyramids, transporting you back in time to witness this amazing feat. Marvel at the tales of great and famous figures of ancient Egypt, including Thutmose IV, Akhenaten, Nefertiti, and Tutankhamun.

After this extraordinary adventure through time, our representative will ensure your safe return to your hotel, leaving you with memories to cherish for a lifetime.

itineraries.title: Evening: Cultural Performance at Wekalet El Ghouri
itineraries.content:
Your enchanting evening begins when our dedicated representative picks you up from your hotel. You will be whisked away in a private air-conditioned vehicle to Old Cairo to visit the historic Wekalet El Ghouri, a beautifully preserved arts center originally built in the 16th century.

18:15 – Arrival & Check-in: Arrive at the venue to settle in before the performance. 19:30 – Show Begins: Prepare to be mesmerized by the Whirling Dervish and Tanoura performance. For approximately 90 minutes (part of the 3-hour experience), immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Egypt. Watch as the "Tanoura" dancers spin endlessly in their colorful, multi-layered skirts, a skill that requires immense stamina and balance. The performance climaxes with the spiritual dervishes spinning in harmony, evoking a deep sense of unity and transcendence, accompanied by traditional Egyptian folk music.

As the show concludes, our team will ensure your safe return to your hotel, leaving you with cherished memories of Cairo's artistic soul.

itineraries.content:
Embark on an unforgettable journey to Alexandria from Cairo. Our dedicated tour guide will meet you at your hotel for a comfortable drive (approx. 2.5 hours) in a private air-conditioned vehicle.

Upon arrival, begin your exploration with Pompey’s Pillar, a red granite column standing over 25 meters high, located at the site of the ancient Serapeum temple dedicated to the god Serapis.

Next, descend into the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, a remarkable Roman-era necropolis. Explore the three levels of tombs, the central shaft, and the unique blend of Pharaonic and Roman art carved into the rock.

Following the historical visits, head to the corniche for a delightful seafood lunch at a premium restaurant overlooking the Old Harbor. Enjoy the sea breeze and refreshing lemon mint juice. Afterward, transfer to your hotel for check-in. In the evening, you may opt for a leisurely stroll with your guide to sample Alexandria’s famous desserts (optional).

  • Meals: Lunch

itineraries.title: Qaitbay Citadel & Library of Alexandria
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before meeting your guide for another captivating day. Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, a majestic 15th-century fortress built by Sultan Qaitbay. It stands on the exact site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria (Pharos), one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and utilizes some of its original stones.

En route back to Cairo, visit the modern Library of Alexandria (Bibliotheca Alexandrina). Opened in 2002 (text notes 1996, but officially 2002), this architectural marvel commemorates the ancient library and serves as a major cultural center.

Finally, enjoy a relaxing drive back to Cairo, with a stop for a hot drink at a rest area along the way. You will be dropped off at your hotel in Cairo.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

itineraries.title: Quad Bike At Giza Pyramids At Sunset
itineraries.content:
Embark on an extraordinary adventure as our dedicated representative picks you up from your hotel in Cairo or Giza in a modern air-conditioned vehicle. You will be transferred to the quad bike station located at the edge of the desert.

Upon arrival, receive a safety briefing and instructions on how to operate your quad bike. Brace yourself for an unforgettable experience as you rev your engine and set off into the golden sands. Imagine the sheer joy of feeling the wind in your hair as you approach the panoramic viewpoints of the majestic Great Pyramids of Giza.

Ride through the desert dunes, enjoying the freedom of the open landscape. Your guide will lead you to the best spots to capture photos of the pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus with the stunning colors of the sunset as your backdrop. This tour offers a rare blend of history and adrenaline, away from the crowds.

After your thrilling ride, you will return to the station and transfer back to your hotel, carrying lasting memories of this unique Egyptian adventure.

faqs.title: Do I need a driver's license?
faqs.content: No, a driver's license is not required to ride the quad bikes in the desert area.

faqs.title: Is it safe for beginners?
faqs.content: Yes, the quad bikes are automatic and easy to operate. Your guide will provide a briefing and assistance throughout the ride.

faqs.title: What should I wear?
faqs.content: We recommend wearing comfortable clothing that you don't mind getting dusty. Closed-toe shoes are essential. It is also highly recommended to bring sunglasses and a scarf to protect your face from the sand and wind.

faqs.title: Is there a minimum age?
faqs.content: Children under a certain age (typically 12-16) may need to ride as a passenger with an adult. Please check specific age policies upon booking.

itineraries.title: Tour To Experience Traditional Egyptian Food
itineraries.content:
Get ready for an extraordinary adventure in Cairo, designed to tantalize your taste buds with the finest Egyptian food and drinks.

To begin your trip, our knowledgeable tour guide will pick you up from your hotel in a private air-conditioned vehicle. You will be whisked away to Downtown Cairo, an area known for its magnificent 19th-century architecture and bustling atmosphere.

Your gastronomic tour starts with a delicious traditional breakfast. Indulge in Foul Medames (slow-cooked fava beans), Ta'ameya (Egyptian falafel made from fava beans), and fresh bread, accompanied by an array of mouth-watering salads and dips like Baba Ghanoush and fried eggplant.

Next, quench your thirst at a local juice shop. Choose from a selection of Egypt’s most famous refreshing drinks, such as fresh Sugarcane juice, sweet Tamarind, refreshing iced Hibiscus (Karkade), or the delicious Sobia (a drink made with milk, coconut, and starch).

Embark on a pleasant walking tour through the lively streets of Downtown, browsing diverse local shops and observing the daily routines of Cairo's residents.

Finally, settle in for a satisfying lunch. You can take your pick from a variety of authentic options, including the famous Koshary (a mix of rice, pasta, lentils, and tomato sauce), savory Egyptian Shawarma, or the delicious Egyptian Feteer (layered pastry often called Egyptian pizza).

As your captivating Cairo food tour draws to a close, we will transfer you back to your hotel, ensuring a seamless and memorable experience.

faqs.title: Is this tour suitable for vegetarians?
faqs.content: Yes, Egyptian cuisine is very vegetarian-friendly. Dishes like Koshary, Foul, and Falafel are naturally vegetarian (and often vegan).

faqs.title: Is the food safe to eat
faqs.content: We select clean, reputable local restaurants and shops that are popular and safe for tourists to ensure a great experience without worry.

faqs.title: How long is the tour?
faqs.content: This is typically a half-day to full-day tour, lasting approximately 4 to 6 hours depending on your pace and traffic.

faqs.title: Can I try street food?
faqs.content: Yes, this tour focuses on authentic local food, much of which is considered street food but served in safe, sit-down environments or reputable stalls.

itineraries.title: Day Tour Itinerary
itineraries.content:
Embark on a fascinating journey into the depths of ancient history as we unveil the wonders of the Egyptian pyramids and historical sites beyond the Giza Plateau.

Your expert guide will pick you up from your hotel in a modern air-conditioned vehicle. Your adventure begins at Sakkara, home to the impressive Step Pyramid of Djoser. Built by the architect Imhotep, this structure is a stunning testament to King Djoser’s reign and stands as the oldest major stone structure in the world.

Continue on to Dahshur, a site that highlights the evolution of pyramid construction. Here, you will have the opportunity to view the Red Pyramid, the oldest "true" smooth-sided pyramid in history, and marvel at the remarkably well-preserved Bent Pyramid, known for its unique angle change.

Take a break to recharge with a delicious lunch at a local restaurant.

End your exploration with a visit to the storied city of Memphis, once the capital of Egypt and a center of government and culture for more than 3,000 years. Witness the majesty of the colossal Statue of Ramesses II and the exquisite Alabaster Sphinx in the open-air museum.

At the end of the tour, our representative will transfer you back to your hotel, leaving you with unforgettable memories of Egypt's glorious past.

faqs.title: Is it possible to enter inside the pyramids at Dahshur?
faqs.content: Generally, yes. The Red Pyramid is often open to visitors who wish to venture inside (climbing down a long tunnel). This is usually included in the site ticket, but please check with your guide on the day of the tour regarding current accessibility.

faqs.title: How is Sakkara different from Giza?
faqs.content: Sakkara is a vast necropolis that predates Giza. The Step Pyramid shows the initial transition from mastaba tombs to the famous smooth shapes seen at Giza. It is often less crowded and offers a distinct historical perspective.

faqs.title: What should I wear?
faqs.content: Comfortable walking shoes are a must, as the ground in Sakkara and Dahshur is sandy and uneven. Dress modestly and comfortably for the weather.

faqs.title: How long is the tour?
faqs.content: This is a full-day tour, typically lasting around 7 to 8 hours depending on traffic and pace.

itineraries.title: Luxor Exploration & Karnak Temple
itineraries.content:
Begin your adventure by flying from Cairo to Luxor. Upon arrival, our representative will greet you and transfer you to the magnificent Karnak Temple (Ipet-it), the largest ancient religious site in the world. Marvel at the grandeur of the "Hypostyle Hall" with its forest of colossal pillars.

Afterward, indulge in a delectable lunch at a high-quality restaurant. Your tour guide will then accompany you to the awe-inspiring Luxor Temple, built by Amenhotep III and Ramses II. Take advantage of some free time for shopping in the vibrant markets of Luxor. Finally, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in and a leisurely evening.

  • Overnight: Luxor
  • Meals: Lunch

itineraries.title: West Bank, Banana Island & Return to Cairo
itineraries.content:
Start your day with a delightful breakfast at your hotel. Cross to the West Bank to visit the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues of Amenhotep III.

Next, journey to the Valley of the Kings, where you will enter three magnificent tombs carved deep into the desert rock, decorated with intricate hieroglyphs and colors. Continue to the Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari, a stunning structure that merges seamlessly with the limestone cliffs.

Savor a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before embarking on a relaxing Felucca boat ride to Banana Island on the Nile River. Enjoy the tranquil natural beauty of the area.

Afterward, you will be transferred to Luxor Airport for your return flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, our representative will escort you back to your hotel.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

itineraries.title: NMEC, Citadel & Khan El Khalili
itineraries.content:
NMEC, Citadel & Khan El Khalili Your adventure begins with a comfortable pickup from your hotel in an air-conditioned vehicle. The first stop is the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC) in Fustat. Here, you will explore a treasure trove of over 50,000 artifacts that showcase the richness of Egyptian heritage across different eras, including the famous Royal Mummies Hall.

Next, you will be whisked away to the Citadel of Saladin, a massive fortress built in 1183 AD to protect Cairo. Marvel at its imposing architecture and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline and the surrounding desert. Your guide will share fascinating stories about the Citadel's construction and its role in Egypt's history.

Following the Citadel, immerse yourself in the sights, sounds, and scents of the famous Khan El Khalili Bazaar. Wander through labyrinthine alleys lined with historic shops selling antiques, perfumes, spices, and jewelry.

Take a break to indulge in a delicious authentic Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant, savoring traditional dishes.

As the sun sets, our team will ensure your safe return to your hotel, leaving you with indelible memories of Cairo's wonders.

  • Meals: Lunch

faqs.title: How long is the drive from Cairo to Alexandria?
faqs.content: The drive typically takes about 2.5 to 3 hours each way, depending on traffic conditions.

faqs.title: Is the library entry fee included?
faqs.content: No, entrance fees to the Library of Alexandria are excluded in the tour price. Note that the library is closed on Fridays and public holidays; in such cases, you will view it from the outside.

faqs.title: What should I wear?
faqs.content: Comfortable walking shoes are recommended. Alexandria can be breezier than Cairo, so a light jacket might be useful in cooler months.

faqs.title: Is lunch included?
faqs.content: Yes, a lunch at a local restaurant is included.

faqs.title: Are there photo opportunities?
faqs.content: Absolutely! The Citadel offers great sea views, and the architecture of the Library is stunning. Photography is generally allowed at most sites, though some museums may have restrictions or extra fees for professional cameras.

itineraries.title: Photo Session At Giza Pyramids
itineraries.content:
Embark on an extraordinary photography adventure with this exclusive photo tour of the Pyramids of Giza. Your knowledgeable tour guide will pick you up from your hotel in a modern air-conditioned vehicle. You will be accompanied by a professional photographer throughout the tour to capture your most cherished moments.

First, explore the majestic pyramids of Khufu (Cheops), Khafre (Chephren), and Menkaure (Mykerinos). Your photographer will guide you to the best vantage points to ensure stunning compositions with these ancient giants.

Next, visit the Valley Temple, where the mummification of kings took place, and stand before the Great Sphinx, the mythical creature with the body of a lion and the head of a human.

During the tour, enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant.

At the end of your visit, you will be transferred back to your hotel. You will receive a digital delivery of 100 professionally edited photos. Additionally, 20 stunning photos will be presented in a high-quality print album and on a USB flash drive, delivered directly to your Cairo hotel within 48 hours.

faqs.title: What should I wear for the photo session?
faqs.content: We recommend wearing bright, solid colors (like white, blue, or red) that contrast well with the desert background. Comfortable walking shoes are essential as the terrain is sandy and uneven.

faqs.title: Can I bring my own camera?
faqs.content: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own camera or smartphone to take your own candids alongside the professional shots.

faqs.title: How long does it take to receive the photos?
faqs.content: The digital photos and the printed album/USB drive will be delivered to your hotel in Cairo within 48 hours of the tour.

faqs.title: Is entry inside the Pyramids included?
faqs.content: No, the tour price covers the general entrance to the Giza Plateau. Entry into the inner chambers of the Great Pyramid (Khufu) or others requires a separate ticket purchased on-site.

faqs.title: Is this suitable for solo travelers?
faqs.content: Absolutely. This is an excellent way for solo travelers to get high-quality photos of themselves without relying on selfies or strangers.

itineraries.title: Day Trip to Luxor from Cairo by Air
itineraries.content:
Experience the wonders of ancient Egypt with our captivating Luxor tour from Cairo. Your journey begins with a comfortable pick-up from your hotel in Cairo, where our expert representative will escort you to the airport for a smooth flight to Luxor. Upon arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by your expert Egyptologist guide.

Start your exploration on the West Bank at the Valley of the Kings. Delve into the inner recesses of rock-hewn chambers and tunnels where pharaohs lay in eternal slumber. Your guide will explain the history and significance of the tombs (guides give explanations outside to preserve the silence and art inside). Traverse vibrant corridors decorated with intricate hieroglyphs and preserved colors.

Next, prepare to be mesmerized by the Temple of Hatshepsut, a masterpiece of ancient architecture built on three impressive levels merging with the limestone cliffs.

A visit to the Colossi of Memnon awaits, where you will see two huge stone statues of King Amenhotep III, the only remains of his once-great mortuary temple.

Indulge in a delicious lunch on one of the idyllic Nile islands, accompanied by a scenic boat trip along the timeless river.

The grand finale of your adventure is the stunning Karnak Temple Complex on the East Bank. Spanning 247 acres, it is the largest religious building ever constructed. Explore the three major temples, the avenue of sphinxes, and the massive columns that represent the achievements of generations of pharaohs.

As your day draws to a close, our team will ensure a smooth transfer to Luxor Airport for your return flight to Cairo. From there, you will be transferred back to your hotel, bringing to an end your unforgettable tour of Luxor.

itineraries.title: Tour to Grand Egyptian Museum, Citadel & Old Cairo
itineraries.content:
Meet your knowledgeable tour guide in the hotel lobby to begin your day.

Our first stop is the magnificent Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), located near the Giza Pyramids. Prepare to be amazed by this architectural marvel. Upon entry, you will be greeted by the Hanging Obelisk and the colossal 3,200-year-old statue of Ramses II. Ascend the Grand Staircase, lined with dozens of royal statues and sarcophagi, leading you to the galleries that house the complete collection of King Tutankhamun—over 5,000 artifacts displayed together for the first time.

Next, we will head to the historic Citadel of Salah El-Din, a medieval Islamic fort located on Mokattam Hill. As we climb up to the Citadel, enjoy the panoramic views of the Cairo skyline and the majestic Nile River. Explore the impressive buildings within the fort, including the beautiful Muhammad Ali Mosque, also known as the Alabaster Mosque.

After a busy morning of exploring, take a break and savor a delicious Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant. Indulge in authentic Egyptian cuisine.

After lunch, we will venture into the charming neighborhood of Old Cairo, where history unfolds at every turn. Visit the Coptic district, home to many ancient churches and the Coptic Museum. Marvel at the Hanging Church (Church of St. Virgin Mary), one of the oldest churches in Egypt, known for its unique location above a Roman fortress gate. Explore the Ben Ezra Synagogue and the Church of Abu Serga, where the Holy Family is believed to have taken refuge.

As our unforgettable tour ends, we will escort you back to your hotel in Cairo, leaving you with fond memories of the Grand Egyptian Museum, the Citadel, and Old Cairo.

itineraries.title: Day Tour to Abu Simbel from Cairo by Flight
itineraries.content:
Join us on an extraordinary journey to the Abu Simbel temples. We will pick you up from your Cairo hotel in a luxury vehicle and transfer you to Cairo International Airport for a flight to Aswan. Upon arrival, you will be met by your professional private tour guide and transferred in a modern, air-conditioned vehicle to the Abu Simbel temples (approx. 3 hours drive).

Our trip begins with a visit to the famous Temple of Ramses II, a colossal structure that represents the pinnacle of ancient Egyptian architectural brilliance. Built around 1250 BC, this temple honors Ramses II and features four massive statues of the pharaoh guarding the entrance. Marvel at the intricate carvings, battle scenes, and historical narratives that resonate within its hallowed halls. Learn about the UNESCO rescue mission in the 1960s that relocated these temples to save them from the rising waters of the Aswan High Dam.

Next, explore the enchanting Temple of Hathor (also known as the Small Temple). Constructed by Ramses II for his wife, Queen Nefertari, and the goddess Hathor, this sanctuary stands as a testament to the king's love. Admire the unique facade where statues of the queen stand equal in size to the king. You can also enjoy panoramic views of the majestic Lake Nasser and its picturesque surroundings.

As our unforgettable journey draws to a close, we will transfer you back to Aswan Airport for your return flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, we will transfer you directly to your hotel, bringing your Abu Simbel adventure to a satisfying conclusion.

Your adventure begins with a warm welcome from our Egyptologist tour guide, who will meet you in the hotel lobby and accompany you throughout the day.

Upon arrival at the Grand Egyptian Museum, prepare to be amazed at its magnificence. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of this great institution, knowing that you are about to embark on a captivating exploration of Egypt’s rich cultural heritage.

One of the highlights of this exclusive tour is the rare opportunity to visit the laboratories and conservation center. Here, you’ll have the privilege of viewing a large collection of ancient Egyptian antiquities, including a comprehensive view of the treasures from the tomb of the legendary King Tutankhamun. Witness the meticulous conservation efforts being made to protect these precious treasures for future generations.

After a truly memorable and informative tour, we will take you back to your hotel, ensuring maximum comfort. Reflect on the profound insights gained during your visit and cherish the memories of this extraordinary journey into ancient Egypt’s amazing past.

itineraries.title: Tour to Giza Pyramids, Grand Egyptian Museum & Old Cairo
itineraries.content:
Embark on an extraordinary day tour after indulging in a delicious breakfast at your accommodation. Prepare to be enchanted when you meet your expert Egyptologist tour guide who will accompany you all day in a comfortable private vehicle. Get ready to explore the following amazing destinations:

Start your journey at the magnificent Pyramids of Giza, famous as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and an iconic symbol of Egypt. Marvel at the three ancient pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure.

Next, learn about the Great Sphinx of Giza, the largest Egyptian statue ever created, standing guard over the plateau.

Take a well-deserved break to replenish your energy and savor a delicious lunch at a local restaurant.

Continue your adventure by visiting the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). Located just 2 kilometers from the pyramids, this state-of-the-art cultural landmark houses over 100,000 artifacts. Stand before the colossal 3,200-year-old statue of Ramses II in the Grand Hall, ascend the Grand Staircase lined with royal statues, and witness the complete collection of King Tutankhamun's treasures, displayed together for the first time in history.

Explore the vibrant tapestry of Old Cairo, a treasure trove of religious antiquities that includes a variety of Islamic and Christian monuments. Discover architectural gems such as the Hanging Church, the Coptic Museum, Omar Ibn Al-Aas Mosque, Al-Azhar Mosque, Salah El-Din Citadel, and many more.

End your exciting day of exploration and discovery as we take you back to your accommodation, allowing you to relax and enjoy a peaceful evening. Think of the wonderful experiences and memories created during this unforgettable journey through the timeless wonders of Egypt.

faqs.title: What is the "Holy Cave"?
faqs.content: Located inside the Church of Abu Serga in Old Cairo, the Holy Cave is the crypt where Joseph, Mary, and the infant Jesus are believed to have rested during their time in Egypt.

faqs.title: Can I customize the tour?
faqs.content: Yes, the pricing table offers flexible options ranging from a full-service package (including lunch and tickets) to a simple car transfer.

faqs.title: Is there a dress code for Old Cairo?
faqs.content: Yes, modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is recommended when entering churches in Old Cairo

itineraries.title: Daily Itinerary: 3 Nights From Aswan to Luxor
Arrival in Aswan & City Tour
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival at Aswan Airport or the Railway Station, you will be welcomed by a representative. The tour begins with a visit to the Aswan High Dam, a significant engineering project completed in 1970. Continue to the Temple of Philae, dedicated to the goddess Isis, and conclude at the Unfinished Obelisk to observe ancient stone-carving techniques. After the tour, board the Blue Shadow for lunch and a relaxing evening.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo, Edfu & Sailing
itineraries.content:
Sail to Kom Ombo to visit the unique double temple dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek and the falcon god Horus. Continue sailing to Edfu. After lunch on board, explore the Temple of Edfu, celebrated for its exceptional preservation. The ship then sails towards Luxor. The evening features a traditional Galabeya party and dinner on board.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West & East Banks
itineraries.content:
Begin the day with a visit to the West Bank of Luxor. Explore the Valley of the Kings, the burial site of New Kingdom pharaohs, followed by the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari and the Colossi of Memnon. After lunch on board, visit the East Bank to see the massive Karnak Temple complex and the Luxor Temple, connected by the Avenue of Sphinxes. The evening includes dinner and disco entertainment.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Disembarkation
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast on board before disembarking at 8:00 AM. You will be transferred to Luxor Airport or the Railway Station for your final departure.

  • Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Daily Itinerary: 4 Nights From Luxor to Aswan
Arrival in Luxor & East Bank
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival in Luxor, transfer to the Blue Shadow for embarkation and lunch. In the afternoon, visit the East Bank to explore the Karnak Temple complex and the Luxor Temple, witnessing the grandeur of these ancient religious sites. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Luxor.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank & Sailing
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, explore the West Bank of Luxor. Visit the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon. (Note: Entrance to Tutankhamun’s tomb requires an extra ticket). Return to the ship for lunch and begin sailing towards Esna and Edfu. Pass through the Esna Lock and spend the night near Edfu.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo Temples
itineraries.content:
Visit the Temple of Horus in Edfu, renowned for its intricate hieroglyphs. Sail to Kom Ombo to visit the double temple dedicated to Sobek and Horus. The cruise continues sailing towards Aswan. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Galabeya party and dinner on board.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Aswan City Tour
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, explore Aswan’s key landmarks. Visit the Unfinished Obelisk to see ancient quarrying methods and the Aswan High Dam, a symbol of modern engineering. Enjoy the final evening on board in Aswan.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Disembarkation
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark from the cruise at 8:00 AM. Transfer to Aswan Airport or the Railway Station for your departure.

  • Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Daily Itinerary: 3 Nights From Aswan to Luxor
Arrival in Aswan & City Tour
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival at Aswan Airport or the Railway Station, you will be warmly welcomed by a representative. The adventure begins with a tour of Aswan's renowned attractions, starting with the Aswan High Dam, an engineering marvel completed in 1970. Next, visit the Temple of Philae, dedicated to the goddess Isis and known for its beautiful architecture. The tour concludes at the Unfinished Obelisk, a massive structure that offers insight into ancient stone-carving techniques. Following the tour, board the MS Radamis I for lunch and a relaxing evening.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo, Edfu & Sailing to Luxor
itineraries.content:
Sail towards Kom Ombo to visit the Temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek. Explore the fascinating mythology and intricate architecture of this unique site. Continue sailing to Edfu to visit the Temple of Horus, celebrated for its exceptional preservation and detailed hieroglyphics. After the visits, the cruise sails towards Luxor. The evening features a lively Galabeya party and dinner on board.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West & East Banks
itineraries.content:
Begin the day with an exploration of Luxor’s West Bank, including the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari, and the Colossi of Memnon. After lunch on board, visit the East Bank to explore the iconic Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple, connected by the Avenue of Sphinxes. These sites reflect the grandeur of pharaohs such as Amenhotep III and Ramses II. The day ends with dinner and evening entertainment.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Disembarkation
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast on board before disembarking at 8:00 AM. You will be transferred to Luxor Airport or the Railway Station for your final departure.

  • Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.content:

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank & Sailing
itineraries.content:

itineraries.content:

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Aswan City Tour
itineraries.content:

itineraries.title: Arrival in Luxor & Transfer to Esna
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival at Luxor Airport or the Railway Station, you will be met by a tour manager. The tour begins with a transfer to Esna, a historic trading town south of Luxor. Accompanied by an Egyptologist, visit the Temple of Khnum, which sits nine meters below the current street level. After a walk through the local streets to view the architecture and market, board the Malouka Dahabiya.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: El Kab & Edfu
itineraries.content:
The ship sails south to El Kab, the site of the ancient city of Nekheb. Explore the Temple of Nekhbet and the decorated tombs carved into the mountainside. The visit includes a walk through the local fisherman’s village. Later, sail to Edfu to visit the Temple of Horus, one of the best-preserved ancient temples in Egypt. The transfer to the temple is by horse-drawn carriage. The day concludes with a sail to a quiet island for the night.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Wadi Muzin & Desert Walk
itineraries.content:
Spend the morning relaxing on the river with an optional picnic and a chance to swim in the Nile. In the afternoon, the boat stops at Wadi Muzin. Here, guests can take a walk into the desert valley to view ancient hieroglyphs and Stone Age inscriptions that mark a historic caravan route. The boat then sails towards Gebel Silsila for the night.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Gebel Silsila
itineraries.content:
Explore Gebel Silsila, a scenic area where the Nile narrows between sandstone cliffs. This site features the rock-cut Temple of Horemheb and the ancient sandstone quarries used to build many of Egypt's great monuments. Enjoy a stop at a local café for tea and shisha, followed by lunch and a swim in the river.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple
itineraries.content:
Sail to Kom Ombo to visit the unique double temple dedicated to two deities: Sobek, the crocodile god, and Horus, the falcon god. The site also houses the Crocodile Museum, displaying mummified crocodiles found in the area. The boat anchors near Kom Ombo or continues towards Aswan for the final evening.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Final Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast on board, disembark from the Malouka Dahabiya. You will be transferred to Aswan Airport or the Railway Station for your final departure.

  • Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Daily Itinerary: 3 Nights From Aswan to Esna
Aswan City Tour & Embarkation
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival at Aswan Airport or the train station, you will be met by a tour director. Begin the day with a guided tour of Aswan, visiting the Temple of Philae, the Aswan High Dam, and the local Aswan Bazaar. Following the tour, board the Sacred Lotus Dahabiya and enjoy lunch while sailing towards Kom Ombo. The boat anchors near Kom Ombo for the night.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple & Gebel Silsila
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, visit the double temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek and the falcon god Horus. Return to the boat and sail to Gebel Silsila, a quieter historical site known for its ancient quarries and the Speos of Horemheb. Dinner is served on the sundeck or near the illuminated temple grounds (weather permitting), accompanied by music.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu Temple & Sailing
itineraries.content:
Sail to Edfu and visit the Temple of Horus, one of the best-preserved ancient temples in Egypt, accessed via a horse-drawn carriage. Afterward, explore the local market before returning to the boat. The journey continues towards Esna, anchoring near a peaceful island. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Egyptian dinner featuring local cuisine and Middle Eastern music.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor Tour & Final Departure
itineraries.content:
Disembark in Esna after breakfast. Transfer by private vehicle to Luxor for a full day of sightseeing. Explore the West Bank, including the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon. Continue to the East Bank to visit the massive Karnak Temple complex. After the tour and lunch, transfer to Luxor Airport or the railway station for your final departure.

  • Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Daily Itinerary: 4 Nights From Esna to Aswan
Luxor Tour & Embarkation in Esna
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival in Luxor, you will be assisted by a tour manager. Begin with a guided tour of Luxor’s West Bank, visiting the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon. Continue to the East Bank to explore Karnak Temple. Following the tours, transfer by vehicle to Esna to board the Sacred Lotus Dahabiya. Overnight is spent on board in Esna.

  • Meals: Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu Temple & Gebel Silsila
itineraries.content:
Sail to Edfu in the morning. Visit the Temple of Horus using a horse-drawn carriage and explore the local bazaar. Return to the boat for lunch while sailing towards Gebel Silsila. Visit the Speos of Horemheb and enjoy dinner on the upper deck or a nearby island, surrounded by the quiet atmosphere of the Nile.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple & Sailing
itineraries.content:
Enjoy a leisurely morning sailing to Kom Ombo. Upon arrival, visit the Greco-Roman Temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to Sobek and Horus. Afterward, continue sailing towards Aswan, observing the rural life along the riverbanks. The boat anchors near the entrance to Aswan for the night.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Aswan City Tour
itineraries.content:
Disembark for a tour of Aswan’s key landmarks. Visit the Aswan High Dam and the Temple of Philae, located on an island. Conclude the tour with a walk through the Aswan Bazaar to see local crafts and culture. Return to the boat for the final evening in Aswan.

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

itineraries.title: Final Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark from the Dahabiya. You will be transferred to Aswan Airport or the train station for your onward journey.

  • Meals: Breakfast
