itineraries.title: Arrival in Aswan – Philae Temple & High Dam
itineraries.content:
before introducing you to your private Egyptologist guide. Your adventure starts with a visit to the magnificent Temple of Philae, located on Agilkia Island. You reach the temple by motorboat, and as you step onto the island, you are surrounded by elegant colonnades, towering pylons, and intricate carvings narrating the myth of Isis and Osiris. Your guide explains how this ancient temple was rescued from rising waters and relocated stone by stone, preserving its legacy for future generations.

You then continue to the impressive High Dam, one of Egypt’s most ambitious modern achievements. Standing before the vast expanse of Lake Nasser, your guide describes how the dam transformed Egypt’s water management, protected the country from floods, and supplied vital electricity.

Your final stop is the lively Aswan Bazaar, where colorful spices, Nubian handicrafts, traditional garments, and aromatic oils fill the air with local charm. After exploring, you board the elegant Amoura Dahabiya and enjoy a freshly prepared lunch as the boat begins its tranquil sail toward Kom Ombo. The gentle movement of the river and the surrounding golden desert landscape set the tone for a peaceful evening on board.

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple & Jabal al-Silsilah – Sailing Through Ancient History
itineraries.content:
A relaxing breakfast marks the start of your day before you step ashore to explore the Temple of Kom Ombo, uniquely devoted to two gods—Haroeris, the falcon god, and Sobek, the crocodile god. The temple's symmetrical design, twin sanctuaries, and detailed carvings reflect ancient beliefs about duality and protection. Your guide brings the structure to life as you walk through its hypostyle halls, learn about ancient medical instruments carved into the walls, and visit chambers once used in crocodile mummification rituals.

Your dahabiya then continues sailing to Jabal al-Silsilah, an archaeological treasure unreachable by larger cruise ships. As you approach the sandstone cliffs, you are transported to a place where pharaohs once supervised the quarrying of stones used to build Egypt’s most celebrated temples. You explore the ancient quarries, rock-cut chapels, and the delicate Speos of Horemheb. The inscriptions and carved graffiti found here offer a rare glimpse into everyday life and religious devotion thousands of years ago.

As the sun begins to set, your crew prepares a special dinner either on the sandy riverbank or on the upper deck. Lanterns glow softly around you, traditional melodies play in the background, and the river reflects the deep colors of the evening sky. This serene experience embodies the true magic of dahabiya sailing.

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu Temple, Local Market Experience & Island Dinner
itineraries.content:
After breakfast on board, you transfer to Edfu by horse-drawn carriage, retracing the same pathways used by ancient priests. Here you explore the Temple of Edfu, the best-preserved cult temple from the ancient world. Dedicated to Horus, the falcon god, its towering pylons, detailed battle scenes, and richly ornamented chambers reveal profound aspects of ancient Egyptian mythology and architecture. Your guide explains the symbolic journey of Horus and Seth, a story carved meticulously across the temple walls.

Following your temple visit, you stroll through Edfu’s bustling local market, where vendors display spices, baskets, handwoven textiles, and traditional crafts. Later, you return to the dahabiya to continue sailing toward a peaceful Nile island. As night falls, you enjoy a magical open-air dinner under the stars. Lanterns illuminate the riverbank, traditional Egyptian dishes are served, and guests often dress in galabeyas or festive attire, creating a joyful and cultural evening inspired by ancient Nile celebrations.

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor Tour – Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple & Karnak Temple
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, you disembark and travel to Luxor, the world’s greatest open-air museum. Your first visit is the Valley of the Kings, where you enter several royal tombs carved deep into the mountains. Inside, vibrant wall paintings depict the journey to the afterlife, protective spells, and the gods who guided pharaohs into eternity.

You continue to the spectacular Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a terraced architectural marvel honoring Egypt’s most successful female ruler. Rising gracefully against the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari, the temple's reliefs depict divine birth scenes and Hatshepsut’s famous expedition to Punt.

A brief stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two immense statues of Amenhotep III, allows time for photography before crossing to the East Bank to explore Karnak Temple, the largest temple complex in ancient Egypt. You walk through the Hypostyle Hall with its towering forest of columns, visit sacred lakes, and see monumental obelisks that reflect the grandeur of Egypt’s New Kingdom.

After completing this extraordinary journey through history, you are transferred to Luxor Airport or train station for your departure.

Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: FULL ITINERARY – 4 Nights from Esna to Aswan
Arrival in Luxor – West Bank & East Bank Tour – Sail to Esna
itineraries.content:
Upon your arrival in Luxor, whether by airport or train station, you are warmly greeted by your tour manager before meeting your expert Egyptologist guide. Your journey begins on the West Bank, where you explore the Valley of the Kings, the eternal resting place of New Kingdom pharaohs. You enter richly decorated tombs carved deep into the mountains, where vibrant reliefs depict the king’s journey to the afterlife.

You then continue to the imposing Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a breathtaking monument carved into limestone cliffs. Your guide explains the fascinating story of Egypt’s most powerful female ruler and the architectural brilliance behind her mortuary temple. A brief stop follows at the Colossi of Memnon, two monumental statues guarding what was once the grand mortuary temple of Amenhotep III.

Crossing to the East Bank, you explore the monumental Karnak Temple Complex, the largest religious structure ever built. You walk among towering columns of the Hypostyle Hall, ancient sanctuaries, ram-headed sphinx avenues, and sacred lakes, learning how this vast complex grew over centuries.

After your Luxor tour, you travel south to Esna, where you board the elegant Amoura Dahabiya. The boat anchors for the night, giving you time to relax as the gentle river breeze ushers in your first Nile evening.

Meals: Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu Temple Tour – Sail to Jabal al-Silsilah
itineraries.content:
You begin your morning with a leisurely breakfast as the dahabiya sails toward Edfu. Upon docking, a traditional horse-drawn carriage takes you through the town to the magnificent Temple of Horus, Egypt’s most complete ancient temple. Its towering pylons, granite statues, and intricate reliefs reveal the epic myth of Horus and Seth, while your guide explains how this sacred site served as one of Egypt’s most important religious centers.

After exploring the temple, you can stroll or ride through Edfu’s lively market, where vendors display aromatic spices, handmade pottery, colorful scarves, and traditional crafts.

Returning to the dahabiya, you enjoy lunch as the boat continues its serene journey toward Jabal al-Silsilah, a secluded site that large cruise ships cannot access. Here, dinner is served either on the riverbank or on deck, creating a magical evening framed by sandstone cliffs and quiet desert surroundings.

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

After breakfast, you explore the hidden world of Jabal al-Silsilah, the sandstone quarries that supplied Egypt’s greatest temples. Walking among ancient inscriptions, rock-cut chapels, and quarry ramps, you discover how massive blocks were cut and transported for monuments like Karnak and Luxor Temple. Your guide shows you the beautifully carved shrine of Horemheb, still bearing delicate reliefs and hieroglyphs.

As the afternoon unfolds, the dahabiya begins its sail toward Kom Ombo, passing serene riverbanks dotted with palm trees, small farming villages, donkeys, and water buffaloes bathing in the Nile. This tranquil stretch of the river offers calm, picturesque scenery ideal for photography and relaxation.

You anchor near Kom Ombo for the night, enjoying a peaceful onboard dinner beneath the star-lit sky.

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple – Aswan Sightseeing – Overnight in Aswan
itineraries.content:
Your day begins with a visit to the Temple of Kom Ombo, dramatically set on a high bend overlooking the Nile. This unique double temple is dedicated to two gods: Sobek, the crocodile deity, and Haroeris, the falcon god. You wander through its symmetrical halls and learn about ancient healing practices illustrated on its walls. The nearby Crocodile Museum showcases mummified crocodiles discovered in the temple’s sacred chambers.

After returning to the dahabiya, you sail onward to Aswan, where you begin an afternoon city tour. Your first stop is the High Dam, offering panoramic views of Lake Nasser and insights into one of Egypt’s most ambitious engineering projects. You then travel by boat to the beautiful Temple of Philae, dedicated to the goddess Isis. Set on Agilkia Island, the temple’s colonnades, reliefs, and sanctuaries create one of the most atmospheric settings in Egypt.

Your day concludes with free time in the vibrant Aswan Bazaar, where Nubian culture comes alive through colors, fragrances, and handmade crafts. You return to the dahabiya for a relaxing final night on board.

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Final Departure
itineraries.content:
Enjoy a final breakfast on board before checking out. Your team will escort you to Aswan Airport or train station for your onward travels, carrying with you unforgettable memories of a serene and luxurious Nile journey.

Meals: Breakfast

faqs.title: 1. Are entrance fees included in the cruise price?
faqs.content: No. Entrance fees to all temples and archaeological sites are always excluded.

faqs.title: 2. What makes a dahabiya different from a regular Nile cruise?
faqs.content: A dahabiya offers slow, peaceful sailing with personalized service and access to hidden archaeological sites that large cruise ships cannot reach.

faqs.title: 3. Is WiFi available on board?
faqs.content: Yes, WiFi is available, but the signal may vary depending on sailing location.

faqs.title: 4. Is the cruise suitable for families?
faqs.content: Yes. The intimate size and calm sailing make the dahabiya ideal for families and couples.

faqs.title: 5. What type of meals are served?
faqs.content: Freshly prepared Egyptian and international dishes served daily onboard.

faqs.title: 6. What should I pack?
faqs.content: Comfortable clothes, sun protection, walking shoes, a light jacket for evenings, and a hat for daytime excursions.

Though the smallest and most affordable among the Nour El Nil fleet, Assouan upholds the same uncompromising standards of exceptional service, gourmet dining, and beautifully appointed accommodations found on every one of their signature vessels.
Sailing gently between Luxor and Aswan, the cruise offers a rare fusion of peaceful river travel, meaningful cultural encounters, and exclusive access to lesser-known archaeological marvels. Enjoy slow, serene sailing, attentive hospitality, and personalized experiences as you explore ancient temples, traditional villages, pristine river islands, and breathtaking desert backdrops.
This is more than a Nile journey — it is an immersion into luxury, authenticity, and the tranquil rhythm of the river.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Luxor & Esna Exploration
itineraries.content:
Meet your tour manager upon arrival at Luxor Airport or Train Station. Begin your journey with a guided visit to Esna, a thriving merchant town rich in character.
Walk through colorful streets adorned with handicrafts and textiles before descending nearly 9 meters below ground to uncover the Temple of Khnum, an archaeological gem hidden beneath the modern city.
After your tour, board the Assouan Dahabiya and enjoy lunch and a peaceful evening on the Nile.
Meals: Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: El Kab & Edfu Temple
itineraries.content:
Awake as your Dahabiya approaches El Kab, once the capital of Upper Egypt. Visit its rock-cut tombs, ancient walls, and the revered Temple of Nekhbet.
Stroll through a traditional Fishermen’s Village before sailing onward to Edfu, home to one of Egypt’s most perfectly preserved temples.
Ride a horse-drawn carriage through the streets to reach the Temple of Horus, a magnificent example of Greco-Roman architecture.
End the day by sailing toward a quiet island where you anchor for the night.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Nile Islands & Wadi Muzin Desert Experience
itineraries.content:
Begin the day with an optional sunrise picnic followed by breakfast. Spend the afternoon exploring one of the Nile’s peaceful islands—perfect for a gentle walk or a refreshing swim.
As evening approaches, venture into the desert valley of Wadi Muzin, where ancient hieroglyphs and prehistoric inscriptions line the cliffs, marking an old caravan route to Libya.
Your Dahabiya anchors near Jabal al-Silsilah, illuminated beautifully under the night sky.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Jabal al-Silsilah & Riverside Serenity
itineraries.content:
Visit the secluded site of Jabal al-Silsilah, a narrow gorge the large river cruises cannot access. Explore the Temple of Horemheb, walk through the ancient sandstone quarries, and enjoy tea and shisha at a rustic riverside café.
Return to the Dahabiya for lunch and a relaxing swim in the tranquil Nile waters before continuing your serene journey south.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple & Sail to Aswan
itineraries.content:
Awaken to a gentle morning sail toward Kom Ombo, home to its unique twin temple honoring Sobek and Haroeris. Explore its sanctuaries, healing scenes, and the fascinating Crocodile Museum, full of mummified crocodiles from antiquity.
Continue sailing toward Aswan, watching the scenery shift beautifully as villages, palm groves, and desert horizons pass by.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Final Departure from Aswan
itineraries.content:
Enjoy your final breakfast aboard before disembarking in Aswan. You will be transferred to Aswan Airport or Train Station, carrying cherished memories of a truly extraordinary journey along the Nile.
Meals: Breakfast

title.rendered: Abundance Dahabiya Boat

content.rendered:
Discover the true essence of slow, luxurious travel aboard the Abundance Dahabiya, where exclusivity meets authenticity on Egypt’s most enchanting waterway.
Inspired by the golden age of Nile exploration—when aristocratic travelers and European elites sailed these elegant, wind-powered vessels—this intimate cruise invites you to relive the romance of a bygone era in unmatched comfort.
Glide peacefully along the Nile, far from crowded cruise ships, and uncover hidden temples, quiet islands, ancient quarries, and charming rural villages rarely visited by traditional cruises. Every stop feels private, every moment unhurried, and every view a masterpiece.
From gourmet meals and thoughtfully curated excursions to serene evenings under the stars, your Dahabiya experience delivers a harmonious blend of luxury, tranquility, and cultural immersion. Abundance Dahabiya isn’t simply a cruise—it is a journey into the soul of the Nile.

itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark in Esna and travel by private vehicle to Luxor. Explore iconic landmarks including the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon, and Karnak Temple.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Luxor & West/East Bank Tour
itineraries.content:
Arrive in Luxor and meet your tour manager. Begin a guided tour through the city’s most important sites: the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon, and the vast Karnak Temple complex.
After sightseeing, transfer to Esna to board your Dahabiya. Spend your first night sailing gently along the Nile.

itineraries.title: Edfu Temple & Silsila Evening
itineraries.content:
Begin your day with breakfast while sailing toward Edfu.
Arrive by midday and take a carriage ride to the Temple of Horus, admired for its towering pylons and monumental granite statues.
After lunch onboard, sail toward the peaceful Silsila Hormoheb Temple. As evening falls, enjoy a beautifully arranged dinner by the temple, on a tranquil island, or atop the Dahabiya’s sundeck—each setting accompanied by curated ambiance.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kom Ombo Temple & Scenic Nile Sailing
itineraries.content:
Wake at your leisure and enjoy breakfast before sailing toward Kom Ombo. Explore the temple’s unique double layout honoring Sobek and Haroeris.
Continue sailing toward Aswan, watching rural life unfold along the Nile: grazing buffalo, farmers’ fields, and palm-fringed riverbanks.
Spend a peaceful night near Aswan’s entry gates.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Aswan Highlights
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark for a full Aswan city tour. Visit the High Dam, explore the exquisite Temple of Philae, and wander the lively bazaar filled with Nubian handicrafts.
Return to your Dahabiya for your final overnight stay in Aswan.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Final Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark from your Dahabiya and enjoy a smooth transfer to Aswan Airport or train station for your departure.
Meals: Breakfast

Whether you choose a 3-night Abu Simbel–Aswan journey or a 4-night Aswan–Abu Simbel adventure, every moment aboard promises sophistication, tranquility, and unforgettable storytelling from Egypt’s ancient past.
Your extraordinary journey begins here—where luxury meets history on one of the world’s most scenic lakes.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Abu Simbel & Temple Visit
itineraries.content:
Arrive in Abu Simbel and check into your luxurious Lake Nasser cruise at noon. After lunch, explore the monumental Abu Simbel Temples, dedicated to Ptah, Amun-Ra, Ra-Horakhty, and Ramses II.
Continue to the elegant Temple of Nefertari, honoring Ramses II’s beloved wife.
In the evening, enjoy the captivating Sound & Light Show at Abu Simbel before returning to the ship for dinner.
Meals: Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Qasr Ibrim, Amada & Wadi Al-Sabwa
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, sail toward Qasr Ibrim, viewing the ancient citadel from the ship due to restricted access. Continue to the Amada Temples, admired for their preserved colors and historical depth.
Sail onward to Wadi Al-Sabwa, where you enjoy the enchanting evening Light Show.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Wadi Al-Sabwa, Dakka & Sail to Aswan
itineraries.content:
Begin with a guided visit to the Temple of Wadi Al-Sabwa, built by Ramses II and guarded by monumental sphinxes.
Continue to the Temple of Dakka, dedicated to Thoth, the god of wisdom.
Sail toward Aswan, enjoying a Nubian folklore show and dinner onboard.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kalabsha, Beit El-Wali & Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, visit the impressive Kalabsha Temple, showcasing Nubian artistry and symbolism. Then explore Beit El-Wali, one of Ramses II’s rock-cut masterpieces.
Transfer to Aswan Airport or train station for departure.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Arrival in Aswan
itineraries.content:
Arrive in Aswan and check into your cruise at noon. Enjoy lunch onboard and spend the afternoon at leisure before an evening Nubian show and dinner.
Meals: Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kalabsha, Beit El-Wali & Sail to Wadi Al-Sabwa
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, visit Kalabsha Temple and Beit El-Wali, two exceptional temples relocated from their original Nubian sites.
Sail toward Wadi Al-Sabwa while enjoying lunch and dinner onboard.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Wadi Al-Sabwa, Dakka & Sail to Amada
itineraries.content:
Visit the mystical Wadi Al-Sabwa Temple, then continue to Dakka Temple, rich in Greco-Roman influence.
Sail onward to Amada, where you visit the region’s oldest standing temple.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Qasr Ibrim & Abu Simbel Temples
itineraries.content:
Sail to Qasr Ibrim for panoramic viewing before continuing to Abu Simbel.
Visit the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples, honoring Ramses II and Queen Nefertari.
Enjoy the unforgettable Sound & Light Show in the evening.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Departure from Abu Simbel
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, check out from the cruise. Transfer to Abu Simbel Airport for your onward journey.
Meals: Breakfast

Whether you choose a 4-day Aswan to Abu Simbel journey or a 3-day Abu Simbel to Aswan sailing, your voyage is marked by luxurious cabins, panoramic lake views, attentive service, delectable cuisine, and expert-guided tours through Nubia’s most extraordinary archaeological wonders.
Relax, unwind, and discover the breathtaking serenity of Lake Nasser—one of Egypt’s most unforgettable cruising experiences.

Arrival in Abu Simbel & Temple Visit
itineraries.content:
Arrive in Abu Simbel and check in to your cruise at noon. Enjoy lunch onboard before visiting the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples—the Great Temple of Ramses II and the Temple of Queen Nefertari, both masterpieces of the New Kingdom.
In the evening, attend the mesmerizing Sound & Light Show before enjoying dinner onboard.
Meals: Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Qasr Ibrim, Amada & Wadi Al-Sabwa
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, sail toward Qasr Ibrim, the only Nubian monument still standing in its original location (viewed from the ship). Continue sailing to Amada, one of the region’s most exquisitely painted temples.
After lunch, sail to Wadi Al-Sabwa, where you end your day with the enchanting evening Light Show.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Wadi Al-Sabwa, Dakka & Sail to Aswan
itineraries.content:
Begin your morning with a visit to the Temple of Wadi Al-Sabwa, built by Ramses II and guarded by an avenue of sphinx statues. Continue to the Temple of Dakka, dedicated to Thoth, god of wisdom.
Return to the cruise and sail toward Aswan, enjoying dinner and a lively Nubian cultural show onboard.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kalabsha, Beit El-Wali & Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark to visit Kalabsha Temple, famous for its intricate carvings and Nubian architectural beauty. Continue to Beit El-Wali, a rock-cut temple of Ramses II featuring impressive battle reliefs.
Transfer to Aswan Airport or train station for your departure.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Arrival in Aswan
itineraries.content:

itineraries.title: Kalabsha, Beit El-Wali & Sail to Wadi Al-Sabwa

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Wadi Al-Sabwa, Dakka & Sail to Amada
itineraries.content:
Visit the Temple of Wadi Al-Sabwa, then continue to Dakka, a unique Greco-Roman temple. After lunch, sail to Amada to explore its beautifully preserved temple complex.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Qasr Ibrim & Abu Simbel
itineraries.content:
Sail to Qasr Ibrim for panoramic viewing before continuing to Abu Simbel.
Visit the breathtaking Abu Simbel Temples, followed by the evening Sound & Light Show. Enjoy dinner and spend the night in Abu Simbel.

itineraries.title: Departure from Abu Simbel
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast before checking out. Transfer to Abu Simbel Airport for your departure flight.

itineraries.title: Qasr Ibrim, Amada & Wadi El-Sebua

After lunch, sail onward to Wadi El-Sebua, where you enjoy an evening Light Show.

itineraries.title: Wadi El-Sebua, Dakka & Sail to Aswan
itineraries.content:

Sail toward Aswan while enjoying a Nubian show and dinner onboard.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Kalabsha, Beit El-Wali & Departure

itineraries.title: Arrival in Aswan & Nubian Show

itineraries.title: Kalabsha, Beit El-Wali & Sail to Wadi El-Sebua

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Wadi El-Sebua, Dakka & Sail to Amada
itineraries.content:

After lunch, sail to Amada, where you visit its beautifully preserved temple complex.

itineraries.title: Qasr Ibrim & Abu Simbel
itineraries.content:

In the evening, enjoy the Abu Simbel Sound & Light Show before dinner onboard.

title.rendered: 9 Days Cairo, Nile Cruise & Hurghada tour

content.rendered:

Begin your journey in Cairo, home to the world-famous Great Pyramids of Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum, where pharaonic treasures captivate your imagination. Continue south to Aswan to board your luxury Nile cruise, where ancient temples in Aswan, Kom Ombo, Edfu, and Luxor reveal Egypt’s most impressive achievements.
After exploring centuries of history along the Nile, unwind by the Red Sea in Hurghada, where golden beaches, coral reefs, and leisure time await. With expert guides, seamless transfers, domestic flights, and thoughtfully designed itineraries, this tour promises an unforgettable Egyptian experience from start to finish.

itineraries.title: Welcome to Egypt
itineraries.content:
Arrive at Cairo International Airport, where our representative and expert guide greet you warmly. Enjoy a seamless transfer in your private A/C vehicle to your hotel. Relax and prepare for the exciting journey ahead.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Cairo: Grand Egyptian Museum & Great Pyramids
itineraries.content:
Meet your guide at your hotel and begin your exploration at the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to remarkable artifacts, original statues, royal treasures, and historical exhibitions that illuminate Egypt’s ancient past.
Continue to the Giza Plateau, where the Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure stand tall against the sky. Capture breathtaking photos and admire the Great Sphinx and Valley Temple, both showcasing Egypt’s incredible architectural mastery.
Return to your hotel afterward.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Fly to Aswan & Nile Cruise Embarkation
itineraries.content:
Fly from Cairo to Aswan, where your guide greets you upon arrival.
Visit the High Dam, offering panoramic views of Lake Nasser, followed by the Temple of Philae, a masterpiece dedicated to Goddess Isis and relocated to protect it from flooding.
After the tour, board your Nile cruise, enjoy your meals, and relax as the ship begins sailing toward Edfu.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo Temples
itineraries.content:
Visit the Temple of Horus in Edfu, one of the best-preserved temples in Egypt, famed for its detailed reliefs and massive pylons.
Return to the cruise as it sails to Kom Ombo. Explore its unique twin temple dedicated to Sobek and Haroeris, featuring elaborate inscriptions and fascinating stories of ancient worship.
Enjoy the traditional galabiya party onboard in the evening as the cruise heads toward Luxor.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank: Valley of the Kings & Hatshepsut Temple
itineraries.content:
Begin your West Bank exploration at the Valley of the Kings, entering carefully decorated royal tombs that reveal the beliefs and artistic mastery of the New Kingdom.
Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a stunning mortuary temple carved into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.
Visit the Colossi of Memnon, two colossal guardian statues that once marked the entrance to the ancient mortuary temple of Amenhotep III.
Return to your cruise after sightseeing.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Transfer to Hurghada
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark from the cruise and meet your guide for a comfortable road transfer to Hurghada. Upon arrival, check into your Red Sea resort and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.
Overnight in Hurghada
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Hurghada Leisure Day
itineraries.content:
Enjoy a full day at leisure in Hurghada. Swim in crystal-clear waters, relax by the pool, explore local shops, or join optional activities such as snorkeling, boat trips, or desert safaris.
Overnight in Hurghada
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Return to Cairo & Free Day
itineraries.content:
Meet your guide in Hurghada and transfer by private A/C vehicle back to Cairo. Check in at your hotel and enjoy free time to explore Cairo, try local cuisine, or shop for souvenirs.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Departure from Cairo
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your private transfer takes you to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight. Take with you unforgettable memories of Egypt’s history, Nile beauty, and Red Sea relaxation.
Meals: Breakfast

title.rendered: 5 Days Cairo, Alexandria & Luxor Tour

content.rendered:
Embark on a remarkable 5 Days Cairo, Alexandria & Luxor Tour through Egypt’s most iconic cities—Cairo, Alexandria, and Luxor. Stand in awe before the legendary Great Pyramids, wander through the world-class Grand Egyptian Museum, and experience the charm of Alexandria’s Mediterranean coast.

With expert guides, seamless transfers, and carefully curated itineraries, this tour delivers an unforgettable blend of culture, architecture, history, and beauty.

itineraries.title: Welcome to Egypt
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival at Cairo International Airport, your tour guide greets you warmly and assists with arrival formalities before escorting you to your private air-conditioned vehicle. Relax as you’re transferred to your hotel to settle in and prepare for the adventure ahead.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Great Pyramids & Grand Egyptian Museum
itineraries.content:
Meet your guide at the hotel and begin your journey through Egypt’s ancient wonders.
Start at the Grand Egyptian Museum, where you explore royal statues, ancient artifacts, and curated exhibits showcasing Egypt’s extraordinary heritage.
Continue to the Giza Plateau, home of the Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Capture panoramic photos, stand before the Great Sphinx, and walk through the Valley Temple, where rituals and mummification ceremonies once took place.
Return to your hotel to relax.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Alexandria Discovery Tour
itineraries.content:
Travel with your guide to Alexandria, Egypt’s Mediterranean treasure.
Visit the Library of Alexandria, a world-renowned cultural institution.
Continue to the site of the Pharos Lighthouse, once one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World; today, the Qaitbay Citadel stands proudly in its place.
Stroll through the Montazah Palace gardens, enjoy views of presidential palaces and coastal landscapes, and stop for photos at historic mosques and statues.
Visit St. Mark’s Church, the oldest church in Africa, and explore the ancient port and downtown Alexandria before returning to Cairo.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Luxor Tour by Flight
itineraries.content:
Fly from Cairo to Luxor for a full day of exploration.
Begin on the West Bank, entering royal tombs in the Valley of the Kings, where vibrant wall paintings and detailed carvings depict pharaonic journeys into the afterlife.
Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a magnificent terraced structure nestled into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.
Visit the Colossi of Memnon, the two massive statues of Amenhotep III guarding the Theban plains.
Then cross to the East Bank to explore the Karnak Temple Complex, with its immense Hypostyle Hall of 134 columns and the beautifully adorned Temple of Amun.
End the day at Luxor Temple, where statues, inscriptions, and ancient courtyards reflect centuries of pharaonic history.
After the tour, fly back to Cairo and transfer to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Departure from Cairo
itineraries.content:
Enjoy a final breakfast at your hotel before your private transfer takes you to Cairo Airport for your departure flight. Leave Egypt with unforgettable memories of pyramids, temples, and timeless beauty.
Meals: Breakfast

title.rendered: 10 Days Cairo, Luxor, Aswan & Abu Simbel Tour Package

content.rendered:

From the Great Pyramids of Giza and the masterpieces inside the Grand Egyptian Museum to the temples of Karnak, Luxor, Hatshepsut, and Philae, every day reveals a new chapter of ancient brilliance.
Explore the royal tombs in the Valley of the Kings, witness the stunning artistry of Abydos and Dendera, marvel at the engineering genius of the High Dam, and stand before the colossal temples of Abu Simbel—one of the world’s most extraordinary archaeological sites.
With private transportation, domestic flights, expert guides, and comfortable accommodations, this tour combines history, culture, and scenic beauty into a once-in-a-lifetime Egyptian experience.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Cairo
itineraries.content:
Your Egyptian adventure begins with a warm airport welcome from our representative, who assists you through arrival procedures and accompanies you to your private A/C vehicle. Enjoy a smooth transfer to your hotel and settle in for the night.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Great Pyramids, Saqqara, Memphis & Dahshur
itineraries.content:
Meet your guide and begin your full-day exploration of ancient wonders.
Stand before the Great Pyramids of Giza, marveling at the iconic structures of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Visit the Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple, capturing panoramic photos of these timeless monuments.
Continue to Saqqara to visit the Step Pyramid of King Djoser, the world’s first pyramid and a groundbreaking architectural achievement.
Head to Memphis, ancient Egypt’s first capital, where you see spectacular relics including the massive limestone statue of Ramses II.
End the day at Dahshur, home to the extraordinary Bent Pyramid and Red Pyramid, offering insight into early pyramid construction.
Return to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Cairo Museums & Bazaars
itineraries.content:
Begin your day at the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to royal statues, ancient sarcophagi, pharaonic treasures, and carefully curated galleries that tell Egypt’s story across millennia.
Continue to the Gayer-Anderson Museum and El Manial Palace, two beautifully preserved heritage sites featuring Ottoman, Islamic, and Egyptian architectural elements.
End the day at Khan El Khalili Bazaar, Cairo’s most famous marketplace filled with colorful lanterns, spices, handcrafts, jewelry, and traditional cafes.
Return to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Fly to Luxor & Explore the East Bank
itineraries.content:
Fly from Cairo to Luxor and begin exploring the East Bank.
Visit Karnak Temple, the largest temple complex in the world, featuring the Avenue of Sphinxes, the impressive Hypostyle Hall with 134 towering columns, and sacred shrines dedicated to Amun, Mut, and Khonsu.
Continue to Luxor Temple, admired for its colossal statues of Ramses II, elegant courtyards, and beautifully carved walls.
Transfer to your hotel for an evening at leisure.
Overnight in Luxor
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank: Valley of the Kings & Hatshepsut Temple
itineraries.content:
Explore the Valley of the Kings, entering richly decorated royal tombs belonging to New Kingdom pharaohs. Admire the detailed carvings and vivid colors that have survived thousands of years.
Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a masterpiece carved into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.
End with a visit to the majestic Colossi of Memnon, two giant statues watching over the Theban plains.
Return to your Luxor hotel.
Overnight in Luxor
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Abydos & Dendera
itineraries.content:
Travel with your guide to Abydos, home to the Temple of Seti I, renowned for its well-preserved reliefs and the famous Abydos King List.
Continue to Dendera to visit the Temple of Hathor, featuring astronomical ceilings, vivid carvings, and one of the best-preserved temple façades in Egypt.
Return to Luxor.
Overnight in Luxor
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo Temples → Transfer to Aswan
itineraries.content:
Travel to Edfu to explore the Temple of Horus, one of Egypt’s most complete and best-preserved temples.
Continue to Kom Ombo to visit its unique double temple dedicated to Sobek, the crocodile god, and Haroeris. Explore its medical carvings and small crocodile mummy museum.
After the tour, continue to your hotel in Aswan.
Overnight in Aswan
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Abu Simbel Tour
itineraries.content:
Travel to Abu Simbel, the crown jewel of Nubian monuments. Stand before the colossal statues of Ramses II and explore the intricate interior chambers of both the Great Temple and the Temple of Nefertari.
These temples are considered among the most impressive in ancient Egyptian architecture, relocated stone by stone to save them from flooding.
Return to Aswan.
Overnight in Aswan
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Aswan Sightseeing → Fly to Cairo
itineraries.content:
Visit the High Dam, an engineering masterpiece overlooking Lake Nasser.
Continue to the enchanting Philae Temple, dedicated to Goddess Isis and beautifully relocated to Agilkia Island.
After your tour, transfer to Aswan Airport for your flight back to Cairo.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Departure from Cairo
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your transfer to Cairo Airport. Depart with cherished memories of Egypt’s pyramids, temples, tombs, and ancient landscapes.
Meals: Breakfast

content.rendered:

With expert guides, seamless transportation, carefully selected accommodations, and immersive itineraries, this 12-day tour offers the perfect balance of culture, archaeology, and natural wonder—ideal for travelers longing for a deep and unforgettable Egyptian experience.

itineraries.title: Welcome to Egypt
itineraries.content:
Your adventure begins at Cairo International Airport, where our representative welcomes you and ensures a smooth arrival. You are transferred in a private A/C vehicle to your hotel to relax and prepare for the days ahead.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Cairo: Great Pyramids & Grand Egyptian Museum
itineraries.content:
Start your day at the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to monumental statues, royal treasures, and thousands of artefacts displayed in breathtaking galleries that tell the story of Egypt’s ancient civilization.
Continue to the Giza Plateau to stand before the Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure. Walk to the Great Sphinx and visit the Valley Temple, absorbing the history, architecture and desert atmosphere.
Return to your Cairo hotel afterward.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Fly to Luxor & Nile Cruise: East Bank Temples
itineraries.content:
Fly from Cairo to Luxor, where your guide greets you and escorts you to begin East Bank sightseeing.
Visit Karnak Temple, a vast complex featuring the Avenue of Sphinxes, the Hypostyle Hall with its towering 134 columns, and the sacred Temple of Amun.
Continue to Luxor Temple, admired for its elegant courtyard, granite statues of Ramses II, and inscriptions illuminated beautifully in the afternoon sun.
Board your Nile Cruise and enjoy dinner as you settle in.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Nile Cruise: Luxor West Bank
itineraries.content:
Begin at the Valley of the Kings, entering impressive royal tombs decorated with vibrant wall paintings depicting sacred rituals.
Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a marvel built into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.
Stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two towering statues of Amenhotep III facing the Nile.
Return to your cruise for lunch and relaxation.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Nile Cruise: Edfu & Kom Ombo Temples
itineraries.content:
Sail to Edfu to visit the Temple of Horus, one of Egypt’s best-preserved temples with colossal columns, carved reliefs, and mythological scenes.
Then cruise to Kom Ombo, where you explore the twin temple dedicated to Sobek and Haroeris, featuring symmetrical architecture and unique medical inscriptions.
Enjoy your galabiya party onboard before sailing toward Aswan.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Nile Cruise: Aswan Highlights
itineraries.content:
Visit the High Dam, an engineering marvel offering panoramic views of Lake Nasser.
Continue to the Temple of Philae, dedicated to Goddess Isis, relocated stone by stone to preserve it from flooding.
Return to the cruise and enjoy your evening in Aswan.
Overnight on Cruise
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Flight to Cairo & Free Day
itineraries.content:
Transfer from the cruise to Aswan Airport for your flight back to Cairo. Upon arrival, settle into your hotel and enjoy a relaxing free day.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Alexandria Full-Day Tour
itineraries.content:
Travel to Alexandria to explore the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, a modern tribute to the ancient library.
Continue to the Qaitbay Citadel, built on the site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria.
Visit the Montazah Palace Gardens, home to royal palaces and Mediterranean views.
Explore historic churches, mosques, and Alexandria’s ancient port before returning to Cairo.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Cairo Citadel & Old Cairo
itineraries.content:
Visit the Citadel of Salah El-Din, one of Cairo’s most iconic medieval fortresses.
Enter the Muhammad Ali Alabaster Mosque, known for its Ottoman architecture and panoramic views of Cairo.
Continue to Old Cairo to explore the Hanging Church, Abu Serga Church, and the Ben Ezra Synagogue.
Return to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: El Bahariya Oasis Tour
itineraries.content:
Travel to Bahariya Oasis to explore its old village, natural hot springs, and sunset viewpoints.
Visit remarkable archaeological sites including the Valley of the Golden Mummies, the Greco-Roman Cemetery, Ain Al-Muftilis Temple, and the Tomb of Bannentu.
Enjoy dinner and overnight desert camping under the stars.
Overnight in Bahariya Oasis (camping)
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itineraries.title: Black Desert & White Desert Tour
itineraries.content:
Embark on a safari into the Black Desert with its volcanic formations, followed by the surreal chalk rock formations of the White Desert, shaped by centuries of wind erosion.
After an unforgettable day, return to Cairo for your final night.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Departure from Cairo
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your private transfer takes you to Cairo International Airport for your onward flight.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.content:
Your experience begins the moment you land at Cairo International Airport. Our representative welcomes you, assists with your arrival, and escorts you to your private air-conditioned vehicle. Enjoy a smooth transfer to your hotel, where you can relax and settle in for the adventure ahead.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Cairo Exploration: Great Pyramids & Grand Egyptian Museum
itineraries.content:
Your guide meets you at your hotel and escorts you in your private A/C vehicle to begin your first full day of exploration.
Start at the Grand Egyptian Museum, the world’s largest archaeological museum. As you walk through its vast halls, you encounter monumental statues, royal artifacts, ancient treasures, and carefully curated displays that showcase Egypt’s unmatched heritage.
Next, head to the Giza Plateau, home of the Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Capture breathtaking views and walk up close to the Great Sphinx, carved from a single limestone block. Your tour continues to the Valley Temple, where rituals and royal mummification ceremonies once took place.
After this immersive experience, return comfortably to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast and Lunch

itineraries.title: Luxor Tour by Flight
itineraries.content:
Your guide transfers you to the airport for your flight to Luxor. Upon arrival, you are greeted and transferred to your private vehicle to begin exploring the ancient capital of Thebes.
Start on the West Bank, entering the Valley of the Kings, where pharaohs of the New Kingdom were laid to rest. Step inside selected tombs adorned with carved passages, hieroglyphs, and vibrant wall paintings that narrate ancient Egyptian beliefs.
Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a magnificent terraced structure built into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari, showcasing the legacy of one of Egypt’s most powerful female rulers. A stop is made at the Colossi of Memnon, where two massive statues of Amenhotep III stand guard.
Move to the East Bank to explore Karnak Temple, the largest temple complex ever built. Walk through the Avenue of Sphinxes, stand beneath the towering Hypostyle Hall with 134 colossal columns, and marvel at the sacred precinct of Amun.
End your day at Luxor Temple, where statues, inscriptions, and royal chapels reveal centuries of ancient history.
Return to the airport for your flight back to Cairo, then transfer to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo
Meals: Breakfast and Lunch

itineraries.title: Departure
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel and reflect on your incredible journey. When it’s time, your private transfer will take you to Cairo Airport for your departure, carrying unforgettable memories of Egypt’s ancient wonders.
Meals: Breakfast

title.rendered: 7 Days Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor & Aswan Tour Package by train

content.rendered:
Discover Egypt’s most iconic destinations in one immersive 7 Days Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor & Aswan Tour Package designed to connect you with the timeless beauty of the ancient world. Begin your adventure in Cairo, where the Great Pyramids of Giza stand as the last surviving wonder of the ancient world and the Egyptian Museum reveals thousands of artifacts that tell the story of Egypt’s extraordinary civilization.
Continue north to Alexandria, the Mediterranean city of legends, where the modern Library of Alexandria, the powerful Citadel of Qaitbay, and the royal Montazah gardens bring centuries of history to life.
Your journey deepens as you fly to Luxor to explore the Valley of the Kings, the grand temples of Karnak and Luxor, and the monumental Colossi of Memnon.
Finally, experience the serene beauty of Aswan, where the High Dam, Philae Temple, and the Unfinished Obelisk unveil the engineering brilliance and spiritual heritage of southern Egypt. With expert guidance, smooth transfers, comfortable accommodation, and optional experiences such as the hot air balloon or Abu Simbel visit, this itinerary captures the very best of Egypt’s ancient treasures and modern charm.

Overnight in Cairo.

itineraries.title: Cairo: Great Pyramids & Egyptian Museum
itineraries.content:
Your day begins with a visit to the Great Pyramids of Giza. You stand before the monumental structures of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure, admiring their engineering precision and breathtaking scale. You continue toward the Great Sphinx, carved from a single limestone block, and the Valley Temple, where rituals for the kings were once performed.
After exploring the Giza Plateau, you head to the Egyptian Museum, home to thousands of statues, royal pieces, and priceless artifacts that highlight every era of ancient Egyptian history. Your guide brings these relics to life as you walk through the museum halls.
At the end of the day, you return to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast and Lunch

itineraries.title: Alexandria City Tour
itineraries.content:
Your guide picks you up from your Cairo hotel for a beautiful drive to Alexandria. Your first visit is the famous Library of Alexandria, a modern cultural landmark built to reflect the legacy of its ancient predecessor. Inside, you explore its stunning architecture, reading halls, and exhibits.
You then proceed to the Citadel of Qaitbay, built on the exact site of the ancient Pharos Lighthouse. From the fortress walls, you enjoy views of the Mediterranean Sea as your guide explains the historical significance of this coastal stronghold.
Next, you stroll through the Montazah Palace gardens, once the royal residence of King Farouk, where lush gardens overlook the sea and the Salamlek and Haramlek Palaces.
Your tour includes stops at important landmarks such as St. Mark’s Church, the ancient port with its iconic views, and downtown Alexandria with its rich mix of heritage and modern life.
After the tour, return to Cairo.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast and Lunch
Note: The Bibliotheca Alexandrina is closed on Fridays and public holidays.

itineraries.title: Luxor Tour: Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Karnak & Luxor Temples
itineraries.content:
You are transferred to Cairo Airport for your flight to Luxor. Upon arrival, your guide meets you and the West Bank exploration begins.
You first visit the Valley of the Kings, entering selected royal tombs decorated with detailed carvings and vibrant colors that have survived thousands of years. You walk through burial chambers that reflect ancient beliefs and scenes from the Book of the Dead.
Next, your tour continues to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, built dramatically into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari, showcasing terraces, statues, and carvings honoring Egypt’s most successful female pharaoh.
A brief stop follows at the Colossi of Memnon, two towering statues of King Amenhotep III that once guarded his funerary temple.
In the afternoon, you explore the East Bank starting with Karnak Temple, the largest temple complex ever constructed. You walk through the Avenue of Sphinxes, stand beneath the immense columns of the Hypostyle Hall, and see the Temple of Amun decorated with lotus and papyrus motifs.
You then head to Luxor Temple, a masterpiece connected to Karnak by the ancient avenue, where elegant statues and inscriptions illustrate the pharaonic legacy.
At the end of the day, you return to your hotel in Luxor.
Overnight in Luxor.
Meals: Breakfast and Lunch

itineraries.title: Arrival in Alexandria
itineraries.content: Upon your arrival in Alexandria, you are welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy free time to relax or explore the coastal atmosphere at your own pace. The beautiful Mediterranean shoreline sets the tone for the remarkable journey ahead.

itineraries.title: Discover the Wonders of Alexandria
itineraries.content:
Your day begins with a visit to the modern Library of Alexandria, a global cultural landmark built to revive the spirit of the ancient library. Inside, you explore its impressive architecture, vast reading halls, and specialized exhibitions.
Next, you head to the Qaitbey Citadel, standing proudly at the entrance of the Eastern Harbor on the ruins of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria. You walk through the fortress corridors while overlooking the sparkling sea.
After your tour, return to your hotel to unwind before preparing for the next phase of your adventure.

itineraries.title: Travel to Cairo – Explore the Pyramids & Sphinx
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, you are transferred to Cairo. Upon arrival, your journey continues to the Giza Plateau where the Great Pyramids stand tall as a testament to ancient Egypt’s ingenuity. You experience the magnificence of the Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, and the Pyramid of Menkaure.
You then walk towards the Great Sphinx, carved from a single limestone mass, guarding the royal necropolis with its mysterious expression. After completing the visit, you head to your Cairo hotel for check-in and a restful evening.

itineraries.title: Cairo Museum – Saqqara – Memphis
itineraries.content:
Your day begins at the Egyptian Museum, home to thousands of artifacts that reveal the evolution of pharaonic culture across different eras. As you move among statues, treasures, and masterpieces, your guide brings each piece to life with expert storytelling.
You then travel to Saqqara, where you explore the Step Pyramid of King Djoser, the first stone pyramid ever built and a revolutionary architectural creation. Finally, you head to Memphis, the first capital of ancient Egypt, to discover its impressive open-air museum including statues, sphinxes, and archaeological remnants.
Return to your hotel in Cairo afterward.

itineraries.title: Fly to Luxor – East Bank Tour
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, you take your domestic flight to Luxor. Upon arrival, you begin exploring the East Bank, starting with Karnak Temple, the largest religious complex ever constructed. You walk through its mighty avenues of sphinxes, towering columns, and sacred halls.
You then continue to Luxor Temple, beautifully connected to Karnak by the ancient Avenue of Sphinxes. Its elegant statues and inscriptions offer a majestic view, especially as the sun begins to set.
Check in to your hotel in Luxor and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank Adventure
itineraries.content:
Your journey through the West Bank begins at the Valley of the Kings, where pharaohs of the New Kingdom were buried in elaborately decorated tombs. You enter selected tombs, where vivid colors and detailed carvings depict stories of the afterlife.
Next, you visit the Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari, an architectural masterpiece built into the cliffs, honoring Egypt’s most successful female pharaoh.
Your final stop is the Colossi of Memnon, two towering statues that have stood guard over Thebes for millennia. After completing the tour, return to your hotel.

itineraries.title: Return to Cairo – Free Time
itineraries.content: You fly back to Cairo and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. This is the perfect opportunity to explore local markets, enjoy Egyptian cuisine, or revisit your favorite spots in the city.

itineraries.title: Final Departure
itineraries.content: After a memorable journey through Egypt’s greatest treasures, you are transferred to the airport for your final departure, carrying unforgettable memories and inspiring stories from your adventure.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Cairo
itineraries.content:
Upon landing at Cairo Airport, your personal tour representative awaits you with a sign bearing your name. After fast-tracking your arrival procedures, you are escorted to your private A/C vehicle and transferred comfortably to your hotel.

The rest of the day is at your leisure — relax, recover from your flight, or stroll around the neighborhood to feel the pulse of Cairo.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: None

itineraries.title: Cairo: Grand Egyptian Museum & Giza Pyramids
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, your guide meets you for a journey into Egypt’s ancient world. You begin at the Grand Egyptian Museum, where thousands of royal treasures, statues, and artifacts reveal the legacy of pharaohs and ancient empires.

Next, you travel to the Giza Plateau. As you approach the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos, the sheer scale of these monuments fills the horizon. Explore the Great Sphinx, the Valley Temple, and enjoy panoramic viewpoints perfect for photography.

After lunch at a local restaurant, you return to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Fly to Luxor & Start Nile Cruise (East Bank)
itineraries.content:
After an early breakfast, transfer to Cairo Airport for your flight to Luxor. Upon arrival, your guide welcomes you and begins your East Bank exploration.

You visit the Karnak Temple Complex, walking through the majestic Hypostyle Hall with its 134 towering sandstone columns. Continue along the Sphinx Avenue toward Luxor Temple, where giant statues of Ramses II and atmospheric courtyards illuminate the heritage of ancient Thebes.

After your tour, board your Nile Cruise and enjoy dinner while watching the sun set over the river.
Overnight on Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank: Valley of the Kings & Hatshepsut Temple
itineraries.content:
This morning, cross the Nile to Luxor’s West Bank — the city of the dead.

Enter the Valley of the Kings, where pharaohs were laid to rest in richly decorated tombs carved deep into the hillsides. You step inside several tombs, seeing walls painted with texts of the afterlife and celestial symbolism.

Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a masterpiece carved directly into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari. End the tour at the massive Colossi of Memnon, guardians of the ancient necropolis.

Return to your cruise for lunch as the ship sails southward.
Overnight on Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu Temple & Kom Ombo Temple + Galabeya Party
itineraries.content:
The cruise docks at Edfu, where you ride to the Temple of Horus, one of Egypt’s best-preserved temples. Walk through its monumental gateway, inner halls, and sacred chambers.

Sail onward to Kom Ombo, where the unique twin temple dedicated to Sobek (crocodile god) and Haroeris (falcon god) overlooks the Nile.

Evening brings a lively Galabeya Party onboard — Egyptian music, dancing, and traditional attire create a festive night.
Overnight on Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Aswan: High Dam & Philae Temple
itineraries.content:
Wake up in beautiful Aswan. Begin your tour at the High Dam, a monumental engineering achievement offering sweeping views of Lake Nasser.

Next, board a boat to Philae Temple, the island sanctuary of Goddess Isis. Saved from flooding, the entire temple was relocated stone by stone — a marvel of modern preservation.

Return to your cruise for an evening at leisure.
Overnight on Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Fly Back to Cairo
itineraries.content:
Check out from your cruise and transfer to Aswan Airport for your flight back to Cairo. Your guide meets you upon arrival and transfers you to your hotel.

Rest and enjoy your evening in the capital.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Alexandria: Library, Qaitbay Citadel & Montazah Gardens
itineraries.content:
Your guide picks you up for a scenic drive (approx. 2.5 hours) to the Mediterranean city of Alexandria.

Start at the Library of Alexandria, a modern tribute to the ancient world’s greatest knowledge center. Continue to Qaitbay Citadel, built on the site of the legendary Pharos Lighthouse.

Stroll through the lush Montazah Palace Gardens, once home to Egypt’s last royal family. Capture photos at Alexandria’s seaside mosque and the statue of Alexander the Great.

Check into your Alexandria hotel.
Overnight in Alexandria.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Alexandria Leisure Day
itineraries.content:
A full free day is yours to explore Alexandria at your own pace.

Walk along the Corniche, relax at seaside cafés, or visit optional sites such as the National Museum or the Catacombs of Kom El-Shoqafa.
Overnight in Alexandria.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Cairo: Citadel & Old Cairo
itineraries.content:
Return to Cairo this morning and begin a deep dive into Egypt’s Islamic and Coptic heritage.

Visit the Citadel of Saladin, rising above the city, and enter the magnificent Muhammad Ali Alabaster Mosque with its Ottoman-inspired domes.

Continue to Old Cairo, where you explore the Hanging Church, the Church of Abu Serga, and the historic Ben Ezra Synagogue. After a cultural afternoon and lunch, return to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Cairo Leisure Day
itineraries.content:
A relaxing free day to explore Cairo on your own. You may visit Khan El Khalili market, modern shopping centers, or add optional tours such as:

  • Dinner Nile Cruise
  • Egyptian Civilization Museum
  • Sound & Light Show at the Pyramids
    Overnight in Cairo.
    Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, your driver transfers you to Cairo Airport for your international departure.

You leave Egypt carrying unforgettable memories of 12 days filled with history, culture, and Nile magic.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Arrival & Cairo Exploration
itineraries.content:
Arrive at Cairo Airport where your tour guide greets you and assists with formalities. Begin your exploration by visiting the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to thousands of artifacts, royal treasures, statues, and masterpieces that showcase the legacy of ancient Egypt.

Continue to the Giza Plateau to marvel at the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos. Explore the Great Sphinx, the Valley Temple of King Khafre, and several panoramic viewpoints ideal for photography.

After your tour, transfer to your Cairo hotel for check-in and relaxation.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Lunch

itineraries.title: Luxor Day Tour by Flight
itineraries.content:
Transfer from your hotel to Cairo Airport for your flight to Luxor. Your guide meets you upon arrival and escorts you to your private vehicle.

Begin on the West Bank, visiting the Valley of the Kings, where tombs are elaborately decorated with painted walls and ancient inscriptions. Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, an architectural masterpiece carved into limestone cliffs. Stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive statues guarding the necropolis.

Move to the East Bank to explore Karnak Temple, featuring enormous columns, sacred halls, and grand statues of Ramses II. Continue to Luxor Temple, where you will walk through its magnificent courtyard, granite statues, and Sphinx Avenue.

After completing your Luxor tour, transfer to the airport for your flight back to Cairo. Your guide will meet you in Cairo for a private transfer to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Arrival & Cairo Exploration
itineraries.content:
Upon arrival at Cairo Airport, your tour guide greets you and assists with airport formalities. Begin your exploration with a visit to the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to thousands of ancient artifacts, statues, royal treasures, and masterpieces that reveal Egypt's glorious past.

Continue to the Giza Plateau to encounter the majestic Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos. Explore the Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple—an ancient ritual site used for purification before royal burials. Enjoy multiple panoramic photo stops capturing the scale and beauty of these landmarks.

After the tour, transfer to your Cairo hotel for check-in.
Optional evening activity: Dinner Nile Cruise with entertainment and folklore show.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Lunch

itineraries.title: Alexandria Discovery
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, travel to Alexandria with your expert guide. Begin at the Library of Alexandria, one of the most significant modern cultural institutions in the world.

Visit the site of the ancient Pharos Lighthouse—one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World—now home to the impressive Qaitbay Citadel.

Continue to Montazah Palace Gardens, once home to King Farouk. Explore its royal palaces (Salamlek & Haramlek) and enjoy views of Alexandria’s beautiful beaches.

Stop for photos at Alexandria’s charming mosque, the statue of Alexander the Great, and explore St. Mark’s Church, the oldest church in Africa.

Visit the historic Ancient Port of Alexandria, offering sweeping views of the city and Mediterranean Sea. Conclude with a tour through vibrant downtown Alexandria.

Return to Cairo for an overnight stay.
Note: Bibliotheca Alexandrina is closed on Fridays and public holidays.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Departure
itineraries.content:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your private transfer to Cairo Airport for departure. Carry with you unforgettable memories of Egypt’s timeless cities and rich heritage.
Meals: Breakfast

Begin your day on the East Bank with a visit to Karnak Temple, the largest religious complex in the world. Walk through its colossal Hypostyle Hall and admire towering statues of Ramses II.

Continue to Luxor Temple, known for its historical significance and impressive open court.

After lunch, cross to the West Bank to explore the Valley of the Kings and Queens, where ancient pharaohs were buried in richly decorated tombs. Visit the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari, a magnificent structure rising from the cliffs.

End the tour at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive statues standing guard over the ancient necropolis.
Return to your cruise for the night.
Overnight on Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Final Departure
itineraries.content:
Enjoy your breakfast onboard before transferring to Luxor Airport for your flight back to Cairo and your final departure. Your unforgettable journey through Egypt comes to an end.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Arrival in Cairo
itineraries.content:
Upon arriving in Cairo International Airport, a representative welcomes you and assists you through arrival procedures. Your tour guide meets you outside the terminal and accompanies you to a private air-conditioned vehicle for transfer to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Grand Egyptian Museum & Great Pyramids
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, meet your expert guide and begin your tour at the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to an extensive collection of ancient treasures, statues, royal artifacts, and masterpieces of pharaonic art.

Continue to the Giza Plateau to visit the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus. Explore the Great Sphinx, the Valley Temple, and several panoramic spots ideal for photographs.

Return to your hotel in Cairo.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Fly to Aswan & Join the Nile Cruise
itineraries.content:
Your guide transfers you to the airport for your flight to Aswan. Upon arrival, your tour guide meets you and escorts you to a private vehicle to begin your Nile Cruise adventure.

Visit the High Dam, offering impressive views over Lake Nasser, followed by a tour of the beautiful Philae Temple, relocated stone by stone to its current site.

Board your cruise and sail toward Edfu.
Overnight onboard the Nile Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, disembark to visit the Temple of Horus in Edfu, one of the best-preserved temples in Egypt.

Return to the cruise and sail to Kom Ombo to explore the dual temple dedicated to Sobek and Haroeris. In the evening, enjoy the traditional galabeya party onboard before sailing toward Luxor.
Overnight onboard the Nile Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor West Bank
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, head to the West Bank to explore the Valley of the Kings, where beautifully decorated royal tombs reveal ancient burial traditions.

Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a stunning mortuary complex built into the cliffs, and stop at the Colossi of Memnon.

Return to the cruise.
Overnight onboard the Nile Cruise.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Luxor East Bank & Flight to Cairo
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, tour the East Bank beginning with the Karnak Temple complex, featuring the breathtaking Hypostyle Hall. Then visit Luxor Temple with its grand statues and impressive courtyards.

After the tour, transfer to Luxor Airport for your flight back to Cairo. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Alexandria Day Tour
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, travel to Alexandria to visit the modern Library of Alexandria. Continue to Qaitbay Citadel, built on the site of the ancient Pharos Lighthouse.

Explore Montazah Gardens, St. Mark’s Church, Alexandria’s ancient port, and downtown landmarks.

Transfer to your hotel in Alexandria.
Overnight in Alexandria.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch
Note: Bibliotheca Alexandrina is closed on Fridays and public holidays.

itineraries.title: Travel to Siwa Oasis
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, begin your journey to Siwa. Explore the Temple of Amun-Ra, the Oracle Temple of Alexander the Great, Siwa Museum, the Mountain of the Dead, Crocodile Tombs, and Dakrour Mountains. End your day with a magnificent Siwa sunset.
Overnight in Siwa.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Return to Cairo – Open Day
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, transfer back to Cairo. Enjoy the rest of the day freely to explore markets, cafés, and cultural sites at your own pace.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Coptic Cairo & Khan El Khalili – Departure
itineraries.content:
After breakfast, begin your tour of Coptic Cairo including Abu Serga Church, the Hanging Church, and Ben Ezra Synagogue. Continue to Khan El Khalili Bazaar for shopping and cultural exploration.

After the tour, transfer to Cairo Airport for your departure flight.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

faqs.content: Yes, this itinerary operates throughout the year.

itineraries.title: Arrival in Cairo
itineraries.content:
Upon landing in Cairo, our representative welcomes you and assists with airport formalities. Your tour guide will accompany you outside where a private air-conditioned vehicle takes you to your hotel. Relax and prepare for the start of your journey.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: No Meals

itineraries.title: Cairo: Pyramids & Egyptian Museum
itineraries.content:
Your guide picks you up from your hotel to begin a memorable exploration.
Start with the Egyptian Museum, home to thousands of ancient artifacts, royal treasures, and monumental statues that reflect Egypt’s rich heritage.

Next, head to the Giza Plateau to stand before the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos. See the Great Sphinx, explore the Valley Temple, and enjoy several panoramic photo stops overlooking the desert landscape.

After the tour, return comfortably to your hotel.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Flight to Sharm El Sheikh
itineraries.content:
Transfer to Cairo Airport for your domestic flight to Sharm El Sheikh. Upon arrival, your guide awaits you at the airport and arranges your private transfer to the hotel.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Moses’ Mountain Adventure
itineraries.content:
Enjoy a relaxed morning at your hotel. At 10:30 PM, your guide picks you up for a desert journey toward Moses’ Mountain. After a three-hour drive to St. Catherine, begin your trek at 2:00 AM, climbing the historic path to the summit. Enjoy the peaceful desert night and prepare for the stunning sunrise.
Experience an unforgettable night of camping on the mountain.
Overnight camping on Moses’ Mountain.
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itineraries.title: Saint Catherine Monastery
itineraries.content:
Wake up at 7:00 AM and descend the mountain with your guide. Then visit Saint Catherine Monastery, one of the oldest Christian monasteries in the world, rich with manuscripts, icons, and the story of Saint Catherine of Alexandria. After the tour, return to Sharm El Sheikh.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.
Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

itineraries.title: Return to Cairo: Open Day
itineraries.content:
Your guide assists with your transfer to Sharm Airport for your return flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and enjoy the entire day at leisure. Explore markets, modern districts, or historical neighborhoods at your own pace.
Overnight in Cairo.
Meals: Breakfast

itineraries.title: Departure
itineraries.content:
Enjoy your final breakfast, then transfer to Cairo Airport for your flight home. Your journey ends with unforgettable memories of Egypt’s beauty and history.
Meals: Breakfast

faqs.title: 1. What is the fitness level required for climbing Moses’ Mountain?
faqs.content: Climbing Moses’ Mountain requires moderate fitness. The trek involves several hours of walking on uneven paths and ascending stone steps. Most travelers can complete it comfortably with short breaks.

faqs.title: 2. Are entrance fees included in the tour price?
faqs.content: No. Entrance fees to all mentioned sites are always excluded from the tour price. Travelers can pay them directly at each attraction.

faqs.title: 3. What should I pack for the trip to Saint Catherine and Moses’ Mountain?
faqs.content: You should bring comfortable walking shoes, warm clothing for the night ascent, a light backpack, water, snacks, and a flashlight. The temperature can be cold at night, even in summer.

faqs.title: 4. Are domestic flights included in the tour?
faqs.content: Yes. The round-trip flights between Cairo and Sharm El Sheikh are included in the package.

faqs.title: 5. Can children join the full itinerary including the mountain climb?
faqs.content: Children can join the entire trip, but the mountain climb is recommended for older kids or teenagers who can handle long walking distances. Families with younger children may choose to skip the climb.

faqs.title: 6. Do I need a visa to join this tour?
faqs.content: Most travelers require an entry visa to Egypt. You can obtain it on arrival at Cairo Airport for many nationalities or apply beforehand from the Egyptian consulate.

faqs.title: 7. What type of accommodation is provided during the mountain camping?
faqs.content: Accommodation on Moses’ Mountain is simple and designed for the adventure experience. Sleeping arrangements are basic, and warm clothing is recommended due to cooler night temperatures.

faqs.title: 8. Is this tour available all year round?
faqs.content: Yes. This program is offered throughout the year. The climb to Moses’ Mountain is possible year-round.

faqs.title: 9. What meals are included in the trip?
faqs.content: Daily breakfast is included during your hotel stays. During the mountain adventure, breakfast, lunch, and dinner are provided. All other meals are at your own expense.

faqs.title: 10. What is the best time to take this tour?
faqs.content: The tour is enjoyable year-round. Many travelers prefer October to April for cooler weather, especially for the mountain climb.

faqs.title: 11. Is transportation private?
faqs.content: Yes. All transfers throughout the itinerary are done via private air-conditioned vehicles for maximum comfort.

faqs.title: 12. Can I customize or upgrade this trip?
faqs.content: Yes. Travelers can request upgrades for hotels, additional nights, or optional tours such as Nile dinner cruises, desert safaris, or Cairo by night experiences.
